sa: तत्र संघर्षजातानां वृक्षाणां पुष्पशालिनाम्॥ प्रस्तराः पुष्पशबला नभस्तारागणैरिव।
en: And the rocks there, covered with flowers falling down from trees, appeared like welkin beautified with stars.

sa: इमास्तु खलु राक्षस्यो यदि त्वमनुमन्यसे। हन्तुमिच्छामि ताः सर्वा याभिस्त्वं तर्जिता पुरा॥ क्लिश्यन्ती पतिदेवां त्वामशोकविनकां गताम्। घोररूपसमाचाराः क्रूराः क्रूरतरेक्षणाः॥ इह श्रुता मया देवि राक्षस्यो विकृताननाः। असकृत्परुषैर्वाक्यैर्वदन्त्यो रावणाज्ञया॥
en: If did you permit me I may say all these shedemons who had tortured you before, distressed you in the forest of Asoka, stricken with grief of your lord, and who are cruel, have grim eyes and who perpetrate always dreadful deeds. worshipful dame, I have heard that these grimvisaged she demons distressed you greatly with harsh words at the command of Rāvaņa.

sa: ततः सा ह्रीमती बाला भर्तुविजयहर्षिता॥ अवोचद् यदि तत्तथ्यं भवेयं शरणं हि वः।
en: Thereat, that bashful maiden, rejoiced at the prospect of her husband's victory, said, If all this prove true, then for certain, (you shall) meet with succour at my hands.

sa: ततो मांससमायुक्तो वायसः पर्यतुण्डयत्। तमहं लोष्टमुद्यम्य वारयामि स्म वायसम्॥ दारयन् स च मां काकस्तत्रैव परिलीयते। न चाप्युपारमन्मांसाद् भक्षार्थी बलिभोजनः॥
en: A crow, at that time, longing to feed on my flesh, tore my breast with its beak. And I threatened it with a pebble. But it continued tearing my breast as if it sat there to feed on my flesh and therefore did not fly off.

sa: इमां प्रतिज्ञां शृणु शक्रशत्रोः सुनिश्चितां पौरुषदैवयुक्ताम्। अद्यैव रामं सह लक्ष्मणेन संतर्पयिष्यामि शरैरमोथैः॥
en: Hear this vow of the foe of Indra, never swerving and instinct with prowess and divinity, this very day will I with unfailing shafts slay Rāma along with Lakşmaņa.

sa: ससंज्ञस्तु मुहूर्तेन स विश्रम्य निशाचरः। तं यक्षं योधयामास स च भग्नः प्रदुद्रुवे॥
en: And in a moment regaining his consciousness and resting (for a while), that night-ranger fought with the Yaksa; and thereat, on being defeated, he* fled. *The Yaksa, that is.)

sa: जानन्ती वत दिष्ट्या मां वैदेहि परिपृच्छसि। भर्तुः कमलपत्राक्षि संस्थानं लक्ष्मणस्य च॥ यानि रामस्य चिह्नानि लक्ष्मणस्य च यानि वै। लक्षितानि विशालाक्षि वदतः शृणु तानि मे।७।।
en: If do you, by my good luck, O Vaidehi, O you having eyes like lotus-petals, knowing me (as his messenger) ask me to describe your lord's person as well as that of Lakşmaņa, I shall relate them to you. Do you hear, O large-eyed dame, what regal signs I have marked on the persons of Rama and Laksmana.

sa: पुरोहितस्यात्मसखस्य राघवो बृहस्पतेः शक्र इवामराधिपः। निपीड्य पादौ पृथगासने शुभे सदैव तेनोपविवेश वीर्यवान्॥
en: And touching the feet of his priest the powerful Rāghava sat on a separate and excellent seat like to Sakra, the lord of immortals (by the side of) Brhaspati.

sa: विष्णो कथं करिष्यामि रावणं राक्षसं प्रति। अहोऽतिबलवद्रक्षो युद्धार्थमभिवर्तते।७।। वरप्रदानाद्बलवान खल्वन्येन हेतुना । तत्तु सत्यं वचः कार्यं यदुक्तं पद्मयोनिना ॥
en: “How shall I, O Vişņu, withstand, the Rákş asa Rāvaņa? The highly powerful Rākṣasa has come here for battle. It is by virtue of the boon that he is powerful, not for any thing else. It is proper to make the words uttered by Brahmă, truthful.

sa: इयं किल पुरी रम्या सुमालिप्रमुखैः पुरा। भुक्तपूर्वा विशालाक्ष राक्षसैर्भीपविक्रमैः॥ तेन विज्ञाप्यते सोऽयं सांप्रतं विश्रवात्मज। तदेषा दीयतां तात याचतस्तस्य सामतः॥
en: This beautiful city, O you furnished with expansive eyes, was formerly inhabited by Räkşasas of dreadful prowess headed by Sumāli; and for that reason, O son of Viśravā, he asks you this. Do you, my child, grant this to him, who is humbly begging for it.

sa: द्वौ मासौ रक्षितव्यौ मे योऽवधिस्ते मया कृतः। ततः शयनमारोह मम त्वं वरवर्णिनि॥
en: I shall wait for those two months, of which I have made a contract, after which you shall have to share my bed. O you of a comely presence.

sa: यो नियुक्तः परं कार्यं न कुर्यान्नृपतेः प्रियम्। भृत्यो युक्तः समर्थश्च तमाहुर्मध्यमं नरम्॥
en: That servant is middling, who, deputed to any task,* do not albeit capable, perform any other work which may be dear to the king. *i.e. performing the entrusted work.

sa: श्वः काल्ये नगरी लङ्कां सप्राकारां सतोरणाम्। रक्षसां च बलं पश्य शरैविध्वंसितं मया।॥
en: On the morning of the morrow behold the city of Larikā with her wall and gates, as well as the hosts of Räkşasas, destroyed by me with my shafts.

sa: पराङ्मुखवधं पापं यः करोति सुरेश्वर। स हन्ता न गतः स्वर्ग लभते पुण्यकर्मणाम्॥
en: O lord of the celestials, he that commits the crime of slaying one that desists from fight cannot go to the celestial regions as the fruit of meritorious acts.

sa: स राक्षसानां निहतं महाबलं निशम्य राजा परिवृत्तलोचनः। समादिदेशाप्रतिमं पराक्रमे प्रहस्तपुत्रं समरे सुदुर्जयम्॥
en: Hearing that a mighty host of the Rākṣasas had been slain, the king, with his eyes whirling in ire, ordered Prahasta's son of incomparable prowess, and invincible in battle.

sa: सोऽपश्यद्रामतीर्थं च नदी बालुकिनी तथा। वरूथीं गोमती चैव भीमं शालवनं तथा॥ प्रजाश्च बहुसाहस्रीः स्फीताञ्जनपदानपि। स गत्वा दूरमध्वानं त्वरितः कपिकुञ्जरः॥ आससाद दुमान्फुल्लानन्दिग्रामसमीपगान्। सुराधिपस्योपवने यथा चैत्ररथे दुमान् ॥ स्त्रीभिः सपुत्रैः पौत्रैश्च रममाणैः स्वलंकृतैः।
en: Beholding the holy river sanctified with the name of Parasurama, the rivers-Balukini, Varuthi, Gomati, the huge forest of Sala trees, the various countries populated with thousands of people, and proceeding a great distance speedily, that foremost of monkeys got at the trees near Nandigrāma* like to those of Caitraratha, the garden of the lord of celestials the flowers whereof were being plucked off by many a damsel accompanied by their children decked in various ornaments.

sa: श्रुत्वा हनूमतो वाक्यं हरीणां प्रवरोऽङ्गदः॥ प्रत्युवाच प्रसन्नात्मा पिबन्तु हरयो मधु। अवश्यं कृतकार्यस्य वाक्यं हनुमतो मया॥ अकार्यमपि कर्तव्यं किमङ्ग पुनरीदृशम्।
en: Hearing his works, Angada, the best of the monkeys, delighted, said-'Drink honey, O monkeys, we must follow Hanumān's advice, who has already been crowned with success. We must follow him even if he lead us to an unworthy action, what of this which is most becoming?"

sa: आर्येण किं नु कैकेय्याः कृतं रामेण विप्रियम्। यन्मया चीरवसनं दत्वा प्रवाजितो वनम्॥
en: What evil had been done to Kaikeyi by the revered Rāma, that along with me, he had been banished into the woods, with rags given him (for his covering)?

sa: यो हि मामुद्यतस्त्रातुं सोऽपि त्वं विनिपातितः।।१० सा श्वश्रूर्मम कौसल्या त्वया पुत्रेण राघव। वत्सला ते यथा धेनुर्विवत्सा वत्सला कृता ॥
en: And you, who was engaged in delivering me, have yourself fallen! And my mother-in-law, Kausalyā, attached (to you), through the death of you, her son, at the hands of Raksasas, has been reduced to the condition of a cow that has been deprived of her calf.

sa: समुत्पाट्य गिरेः शृङ्ग समृगव्यालपादपम्। जघान् हनुमान् वीरो राक्षसौ कपिकुञ्जरः। गिरिशृङ्गसुनिष्पिष्टौ तिलशस्तौ बभूवतुः॥
en: That elephantine monkey, the heroic Hanumān, uprooting a mountain-peak with beasts, snakes, and trees (in it), slew those Raksasas; and, crushed by that mountainsummit, they were reduced to powder.

sa: आख्याहि मम तत्त्वेन राक्षसानां बलाबलम्॥ एवमुक्तं तदा रक्षो रामेणाक्लिष्टकर्मणा। रावणस्य बलं सर्वमाख्यातुमुपचक्रमे।४।।
en: Do you relate to me truly the strength and weakness of the enemies. Being thus accosted by Råma unwearied actions, the Raksasa, began to describe the strength of Rāvana.

sa: निहत्य तां राक्षसराजवाहिनी रामस्तदा शक्रसमो महात्मा।। अस्त्रेषु शस्त्रेषु जितक्लमश्च संस्तूयते देवगणैः प्रहृष्टैः॥
en: The high-souled Rāma, equalling Śakra in prowess, thus slaying the huge host of the lord of Rākşasas and assailing them with shafts and weapons-the celestials, delighted, saying his praises.

sa: दत्ता ममेयं पित्रा तु लङ्का शून्या निशाचरैः। निवेशिता च मे रक्षो दानमानादिभिर्गुणैः॥
en: My father had given this to me, when it had been emptied of night-rangers; and, O Raksasa, I have inhabited this place, furnished with charity, honour and other virtues.

sa: पुनश्च सोऽचिन्तयदात्तरूपो ध्रुवं विशिष्टा गुणतो हि सीता। अथायमस्यां कृतवान् महात्मा लङ्केश्वरः कष्टमनार्यकर्म॥
en: Again reflected he, “Sītā is crowned with chastity and other virtues; and the powerful lord of Lankā, assuming an illusory form, has with much ado perpetrated this ignominious act.”

sa: जङ्गमाः स्थावराश्चैव दिवि वा यदि वा भुवि। सर्वे कालात्मकाः सर्प कालात्मकमिदं जगत्॥
en: All creatures, mobile and immobile, in heaven, or earth, are pervaded by the influence of Kala. The whole universe, O serpent, is permeated by this same influence of Kala.

sa: तदेव च यथा सूत्रं सुवर्णे वर्तते पुनः। मुक्तास्वथ प्रवालेषु मृन्मये राजते तथा॥ तद्वद् गोऽश्वमनुष्येषु तद्वद्धस्तिमृगादिषु। तद्वत् कीटपतङ्गेषु प्रसक्तात्मा स्वकर्मभिः॥
en: As a thread may lie within gold or a pearl or a coral or any earthen object, so one's soul, for his own acts, may live within a cow, a horse, a man, an elephant or any other animal, or with a worm or an insect.

sa: ततस्तु शक्तिं रुचिरोग्रदण्डां मणिप्रवेकोज्ज्वलितां प्रदीप्ताम्। चिक्षेप वेगात् सुभृशं महात्मा मद्राधिपाय प्रवरः कुरूणाम्॥
en: The chief of the Kurus then hurled with great force at the king of the Madras that blazing dart of beautiful and fierce handle set with gems and corals.

sa: कथं नु जीवता शक्यो मया द्रष्टुं हरीश्वरः। तौ वा पुरुषशार्दूलौ कार्यसर्वस्वघातिना ॥
en: For, living, I shall not be able to face that lord of monkeys, and how shall I, having spoilt their work utterly, show myself to those foremost of men?

sa: वृद्धां प्रव्रजितां चैव तथैव च पतिव्रताम्। तथा निकृष्टवर्णां च वर्णोत्कृष्टां च वर्जयेत्॥ अयोनि च वियोनि च न गच्छेत विचक्षणः।
en: A wise man should never know a woman who is old, or one who has given up the domestic mode of life for entering the forest mode, or one who is faithful to her husband or one whose organs of generation are not healthy or well-formed.

sa: यः पूर्वं सुकृतं भुङ्क्त पश्चानिरयमेव सः॥ पूर्वं नरकभाग् यस्तु पश्चात् स्वर्गमुपैति सः।
en: He who enjoys first the fruits of his good deeds must afterwards suffer Hell. He on the other hand, who first endures Hell, must afterwards enjoy the celestial region.

sa: स्वस्ति वाच्य द्विजानादौ ततः कार्ये प्रवर्तिते। समाप्ते पर्वणि तत: स्वशक्त्या पूजयेद् द्विजान्।५५।
en: Causing the Brahmanas to utter benedictions the business of recitation should be begun. When a Parvan is finished, the Brahmanas should be adored to the best of one's power.

sa: वाजिनां खुरशब्देन रथनेमिस्वनेन च। पत्तीनां चापि शब्देन नागानां बृंहितेन च॥ वादित्राणां च घोषेण शङ्खानां निनदेन च। अभवन्नादिता भूमिर्निर्घातैरिव भारत॥
en: With the sound caused by the trampling of horses, the wheels of cars, the shouts of footsoldiers, the grunts of clephants, the beating of drums and other musical instruments and the blare of conchs, the earth began to resound as if with deafening peals of thunder.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच शूरो नाम यदुश्रेष्ठो वसुदेवपिताभवत्। तस्य कन्या पृथा नाम रूपेणाप्रतिमा भुवि॥
en: Vaishampayana said: There was a chief among the Yadus, named Shura, who was the father of Vasudeva. His daughter was named Pritha, she was matchless in beauty on earth.

sa: हतं दृष्ट्वा च शैनेयं पुत्रं च यदुनन्दनः॥ एरकानां ततो मुष्टिं कोपाज्जग्राह केशवः।
en: Seeing his own son, and the son of Shini too, killed, the delighter of the Yadus took up, in anger, a handful of the Eraka grass which grew there.

sa: यदा पश्यति चारेण सर्वभूतानि भूमिपः। क्षेमं च कृत्वा व्रजति तदा भवति भास्करः॥
en: When he marks through his spies the acts of all persons and does what is for the general behoof, he is said to put on the form of Aditya.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच कुशलप्रश्नसंयुक्तं कुशलो वाक्यकर्मणि। कच्चित् ते वर्धते राजस्तपो दमशमौ च ते॥
en: Vaishampayana said To the old king who said so, Yudhishthira, knowing morality and justice and well-skilled in acts and speech, spoke as follows, putting some questions about his well-being.

sa: स चाब्रवीदयं ते स पुत्रहा पन्नगाधमः। ब्रूहि क्षिप्रं महाभागे वध्यतां केन हेतुना॥
en: He then said to her. This wretched serpent has been the cause of your son's death. O blessed lady! Tell me quickly how this wretch is to be killed!

sa: एतच्छुत्वा शमं गच्छ मा भूः शोकपरो नृप। स्वकर्मप्रत्ययाँल्लोकान् सर्वे गच्छन्ति वै नृप॥
en: Having heard all this, O king, do you forego all grief, and acquire peace of mind! Men attain to heaven or hell as the result of their own Karma.

sa: श्रीश्च कीर्तिस्तथा विद्या भवन्ति सहिताः सदा॥ धर्मे चार्थे च कामे च मोक्षे च भरतर्षभ। यदिहास्ति तदन्यत्र यन्नेहास्ति न कुत्रचित्॥
en: The woman big with child gets either a son or a daughter highly blessed. The powerful Island-born Krishna, who will not have to come back, and who is Liberation incarnate, made an abstract of the Bharata, moved by the desire of helping the cause of virtue.

sa: गता भगवती रात्रिः श्रोतव्यं परमं श्रुतम्। तराम सरितां श्रेष्ठां पुण्यां त्रिपथगां नदीम्॥
en: The auspicious night is past, and we shall (again) listen to your wonderful narrations. Let us now cross over this sacred stream, foremost of rivers, wending in three ways.

sa: जित्वा वै क्षत्रियान् सर्वान् ब्राह्मणेषु प्रतिश्रुता। ब्राह्मणः क्षत्रियो वैश्यः शूद्रश्चैव रणे यदि॥
en: Having conquered all the Kshatriyas at the time you made this promise to the Brahmanas. "If a Brahmana or a Kshatriya or a Vaishya or a Shudra in battle,

sa: दिष्ट्या त्वयार्जितं वित्तं प्रतिपाणाय नैषध। दिष्ट्या च दुष्कृतं कर्म दमयन्त्याः क्षयं गतम्॥
en: “O Naishadha, by good fortune you have acquired the vast wealth, in order to stake it back again. Most fortunately the adversity of Damayanti has come to an end.

sa: तमुवाच कलि तो वेपमानः कृताञ्जलिः। कोपं संयच्छ नृपते कीर्तिं दास्यामि ते पराम्॥
en: Kali became frightened; and, trembling with fear, folded his hands; and said to him this: “O king, restrain your anger and, in return, I will impart you great fame.

sa: भूयश्च ते वरं दद्मि तं त्वं गृह्णीष्व सुव्रत। प्रसन्नवदनो भूत्वा तदिहैकमनाः शृणु॥
en: O you of excellent vows, I shall grant you again some more boons. Take them from me. Removing this cheerlessness that overspreads your face, hear me with rapt attention.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच किंशीला: किंसमाचाराः कथंरूपाश्च भारत। किंसन्नाहाः कथंशस्त्रा जनाः स्युः संगरे क्षमाः॥
en: Yudhishthira said Of what nature, of what conduct, of what form, how clad, and how armed should the warriors be in order that they may be competent for battle?

sa: अशोकवनिकामध्ये मैथिली नीयतामिति। तत्रेयं रक्ष्यतां गूढं युष्माभिः परिवारिता॥ तत्रैनां तर्जनैोरैः पुनः सान्त्वैश्च मैथिलीम्। आनयध्वं वशं सर्वा वन्यां गजवधूमिव ॥
en: Do you take Maithilī to the wood of Asokas. There surrounding her, do you secretly guard her; and there (sometimes) by storming, and (at other) by means of soft speech, do you all strive to bring Mithila's daughter, like a wild female elephant, under your sway.

sa: प्रतिषिध्य शुभं छत्रं व्यजने च स्वलंकृते। विसर्जयित्वा स्वजनं रथं पौरांस्तथा जनान्॥ धारयन् मनसा दु:खमिन्द्रियाणि निगृह्य च। प्रविवेशात्मवान् वेश्म मातुरप्रियशंसिवान्॥
en: Leaving aside the excellent umbrella and well adorned chowries, forsaking his relatives, chariot, citizens and other people, calmly bearing the affliction in mind and not manifesting the outward signs of sorrow, Rāma, with a view to communicate this unpleasant news to his mother, entered her abode.

sa: समुद्वहन्तः सलिलातिभारं बलाकिनो वारिधरा नदन्तः। महत्सु शृङ्गेषु महीधराणां विश्रम्य विश्रम्य पुनः प्रयान्ति॥
en: (In this season) clouds, surrounded by cranes and heavily laden with water, are constantly moving, sometimes resting on the high summits of the mountains and emitting a muttering sound,

sa: संजय उवाच ततः प्रववृते युद्धं कुरूणां भयवर्धनम्। संजयैः सह राजेन्द्र घोरं देवासुरोपमम्॥
en: Sanjaya said Then took place the battle between the Kurus and the Srinjayas, O king, that was as fierce and awful as that between the celestials and the Asuras.

sa: उमोवाच मनसा बद्ध्यते येन कर्मणा पुरुषः सदा। तन्मे ब्रूहि महाभाग देवदेव पिनाकधृत्॥
en: Uma said Tell me, O god of gods, O holder of Pinaka, O you who are highly blessed, what those thoughts are by which a person may be fettered.

sa: एतेषामप्युपायानां यस्ते निर्दोषवान् मतः। तस्य प्रयोगमातिष्ठ पुरा कालोऽतिवर्तते॥ यावद्ध्यकृतविश्वासा दुपदे पार्थिवर्षभे। तावदेव हि ते शक्या न शक्यास्तु ततः परम्॥
en: O father, employ any of these means which appear to you faultless. Time passes away, we should not make any further delay. So long their confidence in that best of kings Drupada is not established, we may succeed, but not after (when it has been established).

sa: संजय उवाच इदं तत् समनुप्राप्तं क्षत्तुर्वचनमुत्तमम्। न बुद्धवानसि विभो प्रोच्यमानं हितं तदा॥
en: Sanjaya said Those excellent words of Khattva have now been verified, which, O lord, uttered as they were for your good, you did not pay any heed to before.

sa: ब्राह्मण उवाच विद्वेषणं परमं जीवलोके कुर्यान्नरः पार्थिव याच्यमानः। तं त्वां पृच्छामि कथं तु राजन् दद्याद् भवान् दयितं च मेऽद्य॥
en: The Brahmana said: O king, in this world when a man asks for alms, men the him who asks for it. I ask you therefore (to tell me) with what feelings you will give me what I ask and on which I have set my heart.

sa: पिशुनां न प्रभाषन्ते मित्रभेदकरी गिरम्। ऋतं मैत्रं तु भाषन्ते ते नराः स्वर्गगामिनः॥
en: Those men who never utter deceitful words which create disunion between friends and who always speak what is true and what promotes good feelings, succeed in ascending to Heaven.

sa: सुखं स्वपिहि गान्धारे श्वोऽपि कर्ता महारणम्। यं जनाः कथयिष्यन्ति यावत् स्थास्यति मेदिनी॥
en: Pass the night in tranquil sleep, O son of Gandhari; tomorrow I shall fight a terrible fight, of which men shall speak so long as the earth will endure."

sa: न न्यूनं मयि कैकेयि किंचिदाशंससे गुणान् । यद् राजानमवोचस्त्वं ममेश्वरतरा सती ॥
en: Oh Kaikeyī, certain it is that you are not acquainted with my foremost virtues, inasmuch as possessing full authority to rule me, you have requested the monarch for this.

sa: आर्यांच पश्य पाञ्चालीं सात्वती च तपस्विनीम्। मां च पश्य सुदुःखार्तो व्याधविद्धां मृगीमिव॥
en: See the reverend princess of Panchala, and the helpless princess of the Sattata race! Look at myself, exceedingly afflicted with grief, and resembling a deer pierced by a hunter.

sa: संश्रुतश्च मया योऽर्थो गुरवे राजसत्तम। त्वदधीनः स राजेन्द्र तं त्वां भिक्षे नरेश्वर॥
en: I have heard, O best of kings, that the object I seek for my preceptor is under your control, O king, therefore, O king I beg you for it.

sa: सौमित्रे पश्य पम्पायाः काननं शुभदर्शनम्। यत्र राजन्ति शैला वा द्रुमाः सशिखरा इव॥
en: Observe again, O son of Sumitra, the picturesque wood-land around the lake, where trees, crowned with large branches resembling the summits of a mountain, appear like so many hills.

sa: अथवा परितोषस्ते वाचोक्त्वा सुमना भव। न स शक्यो युधा जेतुमन्यं कुरु मनोरथम्॥
en: Better satisfy yourself and make your mind comfortable by saying this. Partha is not to be conquered in battle. Better fulfill some other object you may have in view.

sa: कुण्डले बाल सूर्यामे मालां हेममयीं शुभाम्॥ घारयन् विपुलं कांस्यं कवचं च महाप्रभम्।
en: His ear-rings were effulgent like the morning sun and his garlands were of gold and exceedingly bright. His body was cased in a massive brazen armour of great effulgence.

sa: स जातमात्रो ववृधे समाः सद्यस्त्रयोदश। वेदं चापि जगौ कृत्स्नं धनुर्वेदं च भारत॥
en: As soon as he was born, he grew into a child of full three and ten years, and quickly mastered the entire Vedas and the whole sciences of arms.

sa: नातः परतरं पुण्यं भूमेः स्थानं भविष्यति। इह तप्स्यन्ति ये केचित्तपः परमकं नरा॥
en: It was so sanctioned by all the foremost celestials headed by Brahman, and by the sacred Rishis, that on Earth there should be no more sacred place than this.

sa: अथ पृष्टः शुकः प्राह मूर्धा समभिवाद्य तम्। स्वागतं देवराज त्वं विज्ञातस्तपसा मया॥
en: Thus accosted, the Shuka bowed to him and thus replied: Welcome to you, O king of the gods, I have recognised you by the merit of my austere penances.

sa: पार्थिवाः स भवांस्तेभ्यो हकस्माद् व्यथते कथम्। भीमसेने च निहते कोऽन्यो युध्येत भारत॥
en: Such are the kings (on my side); why do you all on a sudden express fear for the enemies. Bhimasena being slain, what other warriors will fight, O Bharata.

sa: स देशः क्व नु यत्रासौ वसते धर्मसंकटे। कथं वा स विमुच्येत नरस्तस्मान्महाभयात्॥
en: Where is that region, so inimical to the practice of virtue, where that person lives, Oh, tell me how that man will be freed from all those great dangers?

sa: अवाशिरास्तु यो लम्बेदुदवासं च यो वसेत्। सततं चैकशायी य: स लभेतेप्सितां गतिम्॥
en: He who lies down with his head downwards, or who lives in water, or who lives secluded and alone in the practice of Brahmacharya, acquires all the desired ends.

sa: वृत्तकामो भवेद्याता रामो मित्रकुलं भवेत्। वयं चाविधवाः सर्वाः सकामा न च शत्रवः॥
en: Rāma's desire would have been encompassed his friends would have been successful (through Vibhīşaņa) we would not been widowed and out enemies would not have got their desires fulfilled.

sa: पूजितो मन्त्रपूर्वं तु विधिवत् प्रीतिमाप सः। तमासनगतं माता पृष्ट्वा कुशलमव्ययम्॥ सत्यवत्यथ वीक्ष्यैनमुवाचेदमनन्तरम्।
en: Being pleased with the due worship with the proper Mantras, he took his seat. His mother, Satyavati, seeing him conformably seated, asked his welfare and made the usual enquiries.

sa: तस्यैव वचनाद् राजन् निवृत्ताः श्वेतवाहनात्। ते न क्लान्ता न च श्रान्ता दृढावरणकार्मुकाः॥
en: Returning, at Karna's command, from their pursuit of Arjuna of white steeds and so unfatigued and in-exhausted, those brave warriors, accoutered in impenetrable mail and armed with tough bows.

sa: ततः प्रायान्महाराज सौबलेयः प्रतापवान्। रणाय महते युक्तो भ्रातृभिः परिवारितः॥ स समासाद्य संग्रामे भीमं भीमपराक्रमम्। वारयामास तं वीरो वेलेव मकरालयम्॥
en: Being thus desired, O king, the powerful son of Subala, the peer of great warriors marshaled in array, marched on-his brothers surrounding him. That hero, affronting the fiercely powerful Bhima in that battle, checked his intrepidity, as if a continent resisting the tides of an ocean.

sa: ततो रथाच्छुकुनिं पातयित्वा मुदान्विता भारत पाण्डवेयाः। शङ्खान् प्रदध्मुः समरेऽतिहष्टाः सकेशवाः सैनिकान् हर्षयन्तः॥
en: Having thrown down Shakuni from his car, the Pandavas, were filled with joy. Rejoicing with Keshava amongst them, they blew their conchs in that battle, cheering up their troops.

sa: तथा माया प्रयुञ्जानमसह्यं ब्राह्मणब्रुवम्। माययैव विहन्याद् यो न युक्तं पार्थ तत्र किम्॥
en: Professing himself to be Brahmana, he used to injure us deceitfully; he has now been slain by deceitful means; O son of Pritha, what is there wrong in this?

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच इत्युक्त्वानुपयौ पार्थं हयं कामविहारिणम्। न्यवर्तत ततो वाजी येन नागाह्वयं पुरम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said Having said these words, Partha started, following the horse which roamed at will. The sacrificial horse then turned towards the road leading to the city of Hastinapur.

sa: भरतस्य वचः श्रुत्वा धैर्यशौर्यसमन्वितम्। लक्ष्मणावरजस्तस्थौ हित्वा सौवर्णमासनम्॥ शत्रुघ्नस्त्वब्रवीद्वाक्यं प्रणिपत्य नराधिपम्। कृतकर्मा महाबाहुर्मध्यमो रघुनन्दन॥ आर्येण हि पुरा शून्या त्वयोध्या परिपालिता। संतापं हृदये कृत्वा आर्यस्यागमनं प्रति॥
en: Hearing Bharata's speech instinct with fortitude and valour, the younger brother of Lakş maņa stood up, leaving his golden seat. And Śatrughna, saluting the king represented: “The mighty-armed second son of Raghu has already achieved a grand work: he formerly governed Ayodhyā empty of the noble one,* bearing in his heart the grief connected with his return. *Rama.

sa: तत एनं शरै राजन् सहसा समवाकिरत्। रजसा चोद्गतेनाथ न स्म किंचन दृश्यते॥
en: Suddenly, O monarch, he covered the remnant of your army with arrows. The dust, however, that was then raised, covered the sky, for which we could not see anything.

sa: रामलक्ष्मणयोर्मध्ये न्यस्याम जनकात्मजाम्। किं व्यलीकैस्तु तान् सर्वान् वानरान् वानरर्षभान्॥ वयमेव हि गत्वा तान् हत्वा राक्षसपुङ्गवान्। राघवं द्रष्टुमर्हामः सुग्रीवं सहलक्ष्मणम्॥
en: And we shall place Janaka's daughter between Rāma and Lakşmana. what is the use of putting the other residents of Kiskindha into trouble? It therefore behove us alone to go to Lankā and after slaying the best of the Rākşasas, to see Sugriva, Rāma and Laksmana."

sa: व्रतं वै मम लोकोऽयं वेत्ति कृत्स्नं विभावसो। यथाहं द्विजमुख्येभ्यो दद्यां प्राणानपि ध्रुवम्॥
en: O Vibhavasu, all the world is aware of this vow on my part that I am surely ever ready to give my very life to the best of Brahmanas.

sa: अन्वन्त इमे देहा भूतानां च सुराधिप। तेन शक न शोचामि नापराधादिदं मम॥
en: These bodies of creatures, O king of the celestials, are all transitory. Therefore, 0 Shakra, I do not grieve. Nor is this form due to any fault of mine.

sa: ममेदमिति नैवैतत् साधूनां तात धर्मतः। वै व्यवस्था भवति यदा पापो न वार्यते॥
en: When sin is not restrained, no one can, in view of the rights of property as sanctioned by the scriptures, say,-This thing is mine and this is not mine.

sa: दर्पो नाम श्रियः पुत्रो जज्ञेऽधर्मादिति श्रुतिः। तेन देवासुरा राजन् नीता: सुबहवो व्ययम्॥
en: The Shrutis say that unrighteousness beget a son named Pride upon the goddess of prosperity. This Pride, O king, brought ruin upon many among the gods and the Asuras.

sa: तद् वाक्यं वालिपुत्रस्य विज्ञाय प्लवगर्षभाः॥ उपस्पृश्योदकं सर्वे प्राङ्मुखाः समुपाविशन्। दक्षिणाग्रेषु दर्भेषु उदक्तीरं समाश्रिताः॥ मुमूर्षवो हरिश्रेष्ठा एतत् क्षममिति स्म ह।
en: Taking to heart the speech of Väli's son, those prime monkeys, sipping water, sat down facing the East. And sitting on the edge of the water on grass pointing to the south, the foremost monkeys, wishing for surcease, thought within themselves,-Even this is fit for us.

sa: शिखण्डी तु ततः क्रुद्धश्छिन्ने धनुषि सत्वरः। असिं जग्राह समरे शतचन्द्रं च भाखरम्॥
en: Thereupon on the severance of his bow, Sikhandin burning with rage and hastening as much as possible, took up a sword and a buckler decked with hundreds of moons.

sa: त्रिदशानां वचः श्रुत्वा तथेति मुनिरब्रवीत्। करिष्ये भवतां कामं लोकानां च महत् सुखम्।।१९।
en: Having heard the words of the celestials, the Rishi said, "So be it. I shall do what you desire and also that which would be beneficial to the world."

sa: धुन्धुमार उवाच अकृतज्ञस्तु मित्राणां शूद्रायां च प्रजायतु। एकः सम्पन्नमश्नातु यस्ते हरति पुष्करम्॥
en: Dhundhumara said Let him who has stolen your stalks be ungrateful to his friends! Let him take birth in a Shudra woman! Let him eat alone any good food.

sa: एषां ह्येकैकशो राज्ञां समर्थः पाण्डवान् प्रति। आत्मानं मन्यते सर्वो व्येतु ते भयमागतम्॥
en: Each of these kings by himself are capable of opposing the Pandavas. Every one considers himself all in all. Let the fear which has come on you be dispelled,

sa: स गत्वा त्वरितो राजन् देवैः सम्प्रेषित: कचः। असुरेन्द्रपुरे शुक्रं दृष्ट्वा वाक्यमुवाच ह॥
en: O king, having been thus sent by the celestials, Kacha soon came to the city of the king of the Asuras; and seeing Shukra there, he thus addressed him.

sa: वाणि वा शरीरं वा वरयैतन्मयोद्यतम्। वृणीष्व किं प्रयच्छामि तुभ्यं द्रोण वदाशु तत्॥
en: I am prepared to give you either my body or my weapons () Drona, tell me without delay what you like to have, I shall give it to you.

sa: स तूर्ध्वरेतास्तपसि प्रसक्तः स्वाध्यायवान्वीतभयः कृतात्मा। चचार सर्वां पृथिवीं महात्मा न चापि दारान्मनसाध्यकांक्षत॥
en: That high-souled Rishi, his sexual passion completely under control, engaged in deep study and devoted to rigid asceticism, fearlessly roamed over the world, having no desire for a wife.

sa: मन्दपाल उवाच ज्येष्ठः सुतस्ते कतमः कतमस्तस्य चानुजाः। मध्यमः कतमश्चैव कनीयान् कतमश्च ते॥
en: Mandapala said : Who amongst these (my sons) is your first born and who is born next to him? And who is the third and who is the youngest?

sa: एवमुक्त्वा कुमारांस्तान् द्रोण: स्वाङ्गुलिवेष्टनम्। कूपे निरुदके तमिन्नपातयदरिंदमः॥ ततोऽब्रवीत् तदा द्रोणं कुन्तीपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः।
en: Having said this, that chastiser of foes, Drona took off his ring and threw it into that dry well. Thereupon, the son of Kunti, Yudhisthira, spoke to Drona thus-

sa: देवदूत उवाच आयुषोऽर्धं प्रयच्छत्वं कन्यायै भृगुनन्दन। सुता। एवमुत्थास्यति रुरो तव भार्या प्रमद्वरा॥
en: The Devaduta said : O Descendant of Bhrigu, give up half of your own life to your bride and O Ruru, your Pramadvara will then rise from the ground.

sa: सा कथं ह्याश्रमे सौम्य वत्स्यामि विजनीकृता। आख्यास्यामि च कस्याहं दुःखं दुःखपरायणा ।।६
en: But how shall I, O gentle one, live in the hermitage being divorced from all my kith and kin? and being afflicted to whom shall I express my sorrow?

sa: अपत्येहेतोः सम्प्राप्तं तथा त्वमपि मामिह। इष्टमेवं गते हि त्वं सा तथैवाद्य वर्तते॥
en: I had connection with you for offspring. I have never wronged you as did not the Rishi (Vasishtha) of old, but you have become jealous as Arundhati (once was).

sa: तं वासुकिः प्रत्यगृह्णादुद्यम्य भगिनीं तदा। न स तां प्रतिजग्राह न सनाम्नीति चिन्तयन्॥
en: Thereupon, Vasuki appeared and offered his sister for the Rishi's acceptance. But the Rishi hesitated to accept her, thinking her to be not of the same name with himself.

sa: गान्धर्वेण च मां भीरु विवाहेनैहि सुन्दरि। विवाहानां हि रम्भोरु गान्धर्वः श्रेष्ठ उच्यते॥
en: O handsome lady, O timid maiden, O beauty of tapering thighs, marry me according to the Gandharva form, for the form of marriage is said to be the best.

sa: सम्प्रहृष्टाः स्म तं दृष्ट्वा देवर्षिममितद्युतिम्। अभिवाद्य च तं पार्थ स्थिताः स्म वीडिताननाः॥
en: O Partha, seeing that celestials Rishi of immeasurable effulgence, our hearts were filled with joy. Having saluted him with revenge we stood before him with faces covered with blushes.

sa: सौतिरुवाच ततः स वासुके?रमपनीय मनोज्वरम्। आधाय चात्मनोऽङ्गेषु जगाम त्वरितो भृशम्॥ जनमेजयस्य तं यज्ञं सर्वैः समुदितं गुणैः। मोक्षाय भुजगेन्द्राणामास्तीको द्विजसत्तमः॥
en: Sauti said : In order to save the king of the snakes, the best of Brahmanas, Astika dispelling the terrible fever of Vasuki's heart and taking it as it were upon himself, went with speed to the sacrifice of Janamejaya which was adorned with all merits.

sa: न मे वागनृतं प्राह नाधर्मे धीयते मतिः। एवं चैव वदत्यम्बा मम चैतन्मनोगतम्॥
en: My tongue never utters an untruth; my mind never turns to that which is sinful. It has been commanded by our mother and my mind also approves of it.

sa: एवं तौ शापमुत्सृज्य ब्राह्मणौ विगतज्वरौ। तां गां हि दुर्बलां वृद्धां ददतुर्ब्राह्मणाय वै॥
en: Having thus imprecated the curse upon the king the Rșis became silent. The cow was old and weak so they both, with mutual consent, conferred that upon another Brāhmaṇa.

sa: स भीष्मप्रमुखान् वृद्धानभिवाद्य प्रणम्य च। धृतराष्ट्रं च कौरव्यं तथान्यान् कुरुसत्तमान्। आमन्त्र्य प्रययौ राजा तैश्चैवाप्यनुमोदितः॥ मङ्गलाचारयुक्ताभिराशीभिरभिनन्दितः। गजवाजिरथौघेन बलेन महतागमत्॥ स राजा देवगर्भाभो विजिगीषुर्वसुंधराम्। हृष्टपुष्टबलैः प्रायात् पाण्डुः शत्रूननेकशः॥
en: After saluting and bowing to Bhishma and other elders and bidding adieu to Dhritarashtra and other best of the Kurus, receiving their permission and performing all auspicious rites, the king (Pandu) set out on his great campaign blessed by all around and accompanied by a great army of elephants, horses and cars. That celestial like king was desirous of conquering the whole earth.

sa: शकुन्तलोवाच यथायमागमो मह्यं यथा चेदमभूत् पुरा। शृणु राजन् यथातत्त्वं यथास्मि दुहिता मुनेः॥
en: Shakuntala said : O king! hear, what I have learnt (from the Rishi), regarding all that happened to me and how I became the daughter of the Rishi (Kanva).

sa: जानामि चेमौ पुत्रौ मे यमजातौ कुशीलवौ। शुद्धायां जगतो मध्ये मैथिल्यां प्रीतिरस्तु मे॥
en: I know that these twin brothers Kusa and Lava are my sons. Yet if Janaki gives evidence of her own purity before the assembly I shall be greatly satisfied.

sa: सख्युः सकाशात्पितरं पित्रा ते धर्षितं पुरा। मृतं सर्प समासक्तं स्थाणुभूतस्य तस्य तम्॥ वहन्तं राजशार्दूलः स्कन्धेनानपकारिणम्। तपस्विनमतीवाथ तं मुनिप्रवरं नृप॥
en: When he heard from his friend how his father had been insulted by your father. He heard that he was bearing on his shoulder a dead snake as motionless as a piece of wood, without doing any injury to the man who had insulted him thus.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच सूक्ष्मो धर्मो महाराज नास्य विद्मो वयं गतिम्। पूर्वेषामानुपूर्येण यातं वानुयामहे॥
en: Yudhishthira said : O great king, morality is subtle, we do not know its course. Let us therefore follow the path trod by the illustrious men of former ages.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच नाकामयत तं दातुं वरं दाशाय शान्तनुः। शरीरजेन तीव्रण दह्यमानोऽपि भारत॥
en: Vaishampayana said : O descendant of Bharata race, Shantanu became unwilling to grant the wish of the fisherman, thought his body was being burnt by the fire of desire.

sa: काम्यकागमनं चैव पुनस्तेषां महात्मनाम्। तत्रस्थांश्च पुनर्द्रष्टुं पांडवान् पुरुषर्षभान्॥ वासुदेवस्यागमनमत्रैव परिकीर्तितम्। मार्कण्डेयसमास्यायामुपाख्यानानि सर्वशः॥
en: The return of the Pandavas to the forest of Kamyaka; the arrival of Krishna to see the sons of Pandu; the arrival of Rishi Markandeya; and his various recitals%3B

sa: सा सभा तादृशी दृष्टा मया लोकेषु दुर्लभा। सभेयं राजशार्दूलं मनुष्येषु यथा तव॥
en: O best of kings, as your Sabha is matchless in the world of men, so is matchless in all the worlds that Sabha which was seen by me before.

sa: सौदासोऽहं महाभाग याज्यस्ते मुनिसत्तम। अस्मिन् काले यदिष्टं ते ब्रूहि किं करवाणि ते॥
en: "O illustrious Sir, I am the son of Saudasa; O excellent Rishi, I am your disciple. Tell me what is your desire now and what I am to do."

sa: ये दन्दशूकाः क्षुद्राश्च पापाचारा विषोल्बणाः। तेषां विनाशो भविता न तु ये धर्मचारिणः॥
en: The poisonous serpents that have always the biting propensity, those that bite for little faults and those who are sinful, will be destroyed, but not those that are virtuous.

sa: सुन्दोपसुन्दावूचतुः त्रिषु लोकेषु यद् भूतं किंचित् स्थावरजङ्गमम्। सर्वस्मान्नो भयं न स्यादृतेऽन्योन्यं पितामह॥
en: Sunda and Upasunda said : O Grandsire, let us then have no fear from any created thing, mobile or immobile in the three worlds, except only from each other.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमाश्वासितान् पुत्रान् भार्यामादाय स द्विजः। मन्दपालस्ततो देशादन्यं देशं जगाम ह॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Having thus assuring his sons, the Brahmana Mandapala took with hirn his wife and children; and leaving that region, he went away to some other country.

sa: कथंचित् तव गाङ्गेय विपत्तौ नास्ति नः कुलम्। असंशयं त्वमेवैकः शतादपि वरः सुतः॥
en: O son of Ganga, if anything happens to you, we shall be sonless and we shall have no descendants. Truly you alone are equal to one hundred best sons.

sa: इमे रथाः काञ्चनपद्मचित्राः सदश्वयुक्ता वसुधाधिपार्हाः। एतान् समारुह्य समेत सर्वे पाञ्चालराजस्य निवेशनं तत्॥
en: These cars, adorned with golden lotus and drawn by excellent horses, are worthy of being ridden by kings. Riding on them, come to the palace of the Panchala king.

sa: युधिष्ठिरो राजपुत्रो ज्येष्ठो नः कुलवर्धनः। प्राप्तः स्वगुणतो राज्यं न तस्मिन् वाच्यमस्ति नः।३१।।
en: “The eldest of the princes, Yudhisthira is the perpetuator of your race. He has acquired the kingdom by virtue of his birth. We have nothing to say to this.

sa: व्युष्टिरेषा परा स्त्रीणां पूर्वं भर्तुः परां गतिम्। गन्तुं ब्रह्मन् सपुत्राणामिति धर्मविदो दिदुः॥
en: O Brahmana, persons learned in the precepts of virtue have said that to predecease their husbands in an act of the highest merit for women who have borne children.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच सा सिच्यमाना त्वष्ठीला बभूव शतधा तदा। अङ्गुष्ठपर्वमात्राणां गर्भाणां पृथगेव तु॥
en: Vaishampayana said : The ball of fresh, being thus sprinkled with water, became divided into hundred parts. They separately became hundred parts, each about the size of the thumb.

sa: कच्चिद् बलस्य भक्तं च वेतनं च यथोचितम्। सम्प्राप्तकाले दातव्यं ददासि न विकर्षसि॥
en: Do you give to your soldiers they proper rations and pay at (the appointed) time? Surely you do not oppress them by withholding from them (their rations and pay).

sa: अयाचन्त च मांराजन् वरं तच्च मया कृतम्। जाताजातान् प्रक्षिपास्मान् स्वयं गङ्गे त्वमम्भसि॥
en: O king, they prayed to me for a boon, saying, "O Ganga, as soon as each of us will, be born, you yourself should throw us into the water."

sa: तमुवाच पृथा राजन् रहस्युक्ता तदा सती। उक्ता सकृद् द्वन्द्वमेषा लेभे तेनास्मि वञ्चिता॥
en: In private, when the faithful Pritha replied to him thus, "Having given her the Mantra only for once, she has got two sons. I have been deceived by her.

sa: शिबिरुवाच पृच्छामि त्वां शिबिरौशीनरोऽहं ममापि लोका यदि सन्तीह तात। यद्यन्तरिक्षे यदि वा दिवि श्रिताः क्षेत्रज्ञं त्वां तस्य धर्मस्य मन्ये॥
en: Sibi said : I am Sibi, the son of Ushinara. I ask you, O king, O sire, is there any region in heaven or in the firmament for me to enjoy? You know every region that one may enjoy as the fruit of his religious merit.

sa: बुधस्य पुत्रो राजर्षिः काशिराजः पुरूरवाः। तमभ्यागच्छ दुर्बुद्धे स ते भर्ता भविष्यति ॥
en: The royal saint Pururava, the king of kasi, is the son of Budha. Do you go to him, O you of a vicious intellect; he shall be your husband.

sa: न ममार च पातेन स यदा तेन पाण्डव। तदाग्निमिद्धं भगवान् संविवेश महावने॥
en: O son of Pandu, when the illustrious (Rishi) found that he was not killed by that fall, he made a huge fire in that great forest and entered it.

sa: वेतकेतोः किल पुरा समक्षं मातरं पितुः॥ जग्राह ब्राह्मणः पाणौ गच्छाव इति चाब्रवीत्।
en: One day, in the time of yore, in the very presence of Shvetaketu's father, a Brahmana came and taking his (Shvetaketu's) mother by the hand said, “Let us go".

sa: ऋत्विज ऊचुः यथा शास्त्राणि न: प्राहुर्यथा शंसति पावकः। इन्द्रस्य भवने राजस्तक्षको भयपीडितः॥
en: The Ritvijas said : O king, Takshaka is now living in fear in the abode of Indra. The Shastra declares this to us and the Fire also says it.

sa: वसिष्ठ उवाच स चक्रे तात लोकानां विनाशाय महामनाः। सर्वेषामेव कात्स्न्येन मनः प्रवणमात्मनः॥ इच्छन्नपचितिं कर्तुं भृगूणां भृगुनन्दनः। सर्वलोकविनाशाय तपसा महतैधितः॥
en: Vasishtha said : O child, the high-souled man set his heart on the destruction of all creatures. In order to pay homage to his massacred ancestors, the descendant of the Bhrigu race engaged himself in the severest penances with the object of destroying the whole creation.

sa: गौतमोऽपि ततो ऽभ्येत्य धनुर्वेदपरोऽभवत्। कृपया यन्मया बालाविमौ संवर्धिताविति॥ तस्मात् तयो म चक्रे तदेव स महीपतिः। गोपितौ गौतमस्तत्र तपसा समविन्दत॥
en: Gautaina also, leaving (his old hermitage), studied the science of weapons. That king gave them the name of Kripa and Kripi, because they were reared up by him out of kindness. Gautama came to know through his spiritual sight where they (his son and daughter) were.

sa: आहुः केचिन्न तस्यैते तस्यैत इति चापरे। यदा चिरमृतः पाण्डुः कथं तस्येति चापरे॥
en: Some, however, said they were not the sons of Pandu; others said they were. Some said how they could be the sons of Pandu who was dead long ago.

sa: समयत्यागिनो लुब्धान् गुरूनपि च केशव। निहन्ति समरे पापान् क्षत्रियो यः स धर्मवित्॥
en: The Kshatriya, O Keshava, knows his own duty who kills in battle his very preceptors, if they happen to be sinful and covetous and negligent of restraints and vows.

sa: वासुदेव उवाच यशसः श्रेयसंश्चैव मूलं मां विद्धि कौरव। मत्तः सर्वेऽभिनिर्वृत्ता भावाः सदसदात्मकाः॥
en: Vasudeva said Know, O you of Kuru's race, that I am the root of fame and of everything that produces good. All things, good or bad, emanate from me.

sa: योऽरिणा सह संधाय सुखं स्वपिति विश्वसन्। स वृक्षाग्रे प्रसुप्तो वा पतितः प्रतिबुद्ध्यते॥
en: That king who having made peace with an enemy sleeps happily and confidently is lįke a man who sleeping on the top of a iree awakes after a fall,

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच कथं राजा प्रजा रक्षन्नाधिबन्धेन युज्यते। धर्मेण नापराध्नोति तन्मे ब्रूहि पितामह॥
en: Yudhishthira said Tell me, O grandfather, how should the king protect his subjects so as to be able to avoid grief and so as not to militate against fairness?

sa: दुर्योधन उवाच सैनापत्येन वरये त्वामहं मातुलातुलम्। सोऽस्मान् पाहि युधां श्रेष्ठ स्कन्दो देवानिवाहवे॥
en: Duryodhana said I wish you to accept the general-ship of my army. O maternal uncle, O foremost of warriors, protect us, even as Skanda protected the celestials in battle.

sa: शूरस्य हि रणे कृष्ण पश्याननमथेदृशम्। स कथं निहतोऽमित्रैः पांसून् असति मे सुतः॥
en: Look, O Krishna at the face of that heroic son of mine. How could that son of mine be killed by enemies and thus made to eat the dust.

sa: निर्वेदयित्वा तु परं हत्वा वा कुरुनन्दन। ततोऽनृणो भवेद् राजा यथा शास्त्रे निदर्शितम्॥
en: It has been laid down in the scriptures, O delighter of the Kurus, that a king satisfies his debt when he defeats his foe or kills him at once.

sa: सत्यं च नापि हर्तव्यं सारविघ्नं च मा कृथाः। पूज्यन्ते यत्र देवाश्च पितरोऽतिथयस्तथा॥
en: You should never sacrifice truth. You should never obstruct the marriages of men. You should never injure those houses in which the deities, the Pitris, and guests and adored.

sa: शीलेन हि त्रयो लोकास्त्वया धर्मज्ञ निर्जिताः। तद्विज्ञाय सुरेन्द्रेण तव शीलं हृतं प्रभो॥
en: O Righteous one, it was by your conduct that you had reduced the three worlds to subjection. Knowing this the king of the gods robbed you of your conduct!

sa: यथा गणाः प्रवर्धन्ते न भिद्यन्ते च भारत। अरींश्च विजिगीषन्ते सुहृदः प्राप्नुवन्ति च।॥
en: I wish to hear how they may advance, how they may be attached to the person of the king, and how, O Bharata, they may subduing foes gain friends.

sa: पिता हि राजा राष्ट्रस्य प्रजाना योऽनुकम्पनः। तस्मिन् मिथ्याविनीतो हि तिर्यग् गच्छति मानवः।।१०४
en: The king by treating his people mercifully is called their father. The subject who plays him false, is born in his next life as an animal or a bird.

sa: भीष्म उवाच यो हि शत्रोविवृद्धस्य प्रभोर्बन्धविनाशने। पूर्वं न सहते वेगं क्षिप्रमेव विनश्यति॥
en: Bhishma said-That person, who does not yield to the power of a powerful foe who has grown and who is competent to imprison or kill, soon meets with ruin.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच दिष्ट्या त्वमपि जानीषे क्षत्रधर्मं सुयोधन॥ दिष्ट्या ते वर्तते बुद्धिर्युद्धायैव महाभुज।
en: Yudhishthira said By good luck, O Suyodhana, you are conversant with the duties of a Kshatriya. By good luck, O mighty-armed heroe, your heart is bent on a battle.

sa: तद् यस्य नाभ्यां सम्भूतं यस्मिन् विश्वं प्रतिष्ठितम्। पुष्करे पुष्कराक्षस्य तस्मै पद्मात्मने नमः॥
en: From the navel of the Self-born having eyes like lotus leaves, sprung a lotus. On that lotus is situate this universe. Salutations to you in your form as lotus.

sa: शेषे ह्यवस्थिते तात पुत्राणामन्तके त्वयि। न मे दुःखं भवेदेतद् यदि त्वं धर्ममाचरेः॥
en: O child, although you live unscathed, having killed all my sons, yet I would not have been sorry, if you had followed the path of righteousness in killing them.

sa: क्षत्रियास्ते महात्मानः शूराः समितिशोभनाः। आशिषं परमां प्राप्ता न शोच्याः सर्व एव हि॥
en: All of them were great Kshatriya, all of them were heroes and ornaments of assemblies. They have attained to a highly blessed state. One should not grieve for them.

sa: न जानीते हि यः श्रेयः श्रेयसश्चावमन्यते। स क्षिप्रं भ्रश्यते राज्यान च श्रेयोऽनुविन्दते॥
en: He that does not know what is for his good or knowing disregards what is for his good, is soon deprived of his kingdom and never obtains any good.

sa: एतदिच्छाम्यहं श्रोतुं निखिलेन परंतप। यथा च ते न भिद्येरंस्तच्च मे वद पार्थिव॥
en: I desire to hear ail this fully, O scorcher of foes. Tell me also, O king, the means by which they may not happen to quarrel with the king."

sa: व्रीडां जग्मुः पुरा याः स्म सखीनामपि योषितः। ता एकवस्त्रा निर्लज्जाः श्वश्रूणां पुरतोऽभवन्॥
en: Those ladies who formerly felt abashed even in the presence of companions of their own sex, now felt no shame, though scantily clad, in coming out before their mothers-in-law.

sa: यस्य सिंहः श्रुभिः कीर्णः सिंहकर्मफले रतः। न स सिंहफलं भोक्तुं शक्तः श्वभिरुपासितः॥
en: That lion, however who while performing the duties of a lion, has a pack of dogs only for his companions, never succeeds for such companionship, in performing those duties.

sa: यो भूतानि धनाक्रान्त्या वधात् क्लेशाच्च रक्षति। दस्युभ्यः प्राणदानात् स धनदः सुखदो विराट्॥
en: He who protects people from plunder, destruction, and affliction, he, for thus saving their lives from robbers, is regarded as the giver of wealth, of life, and of food.

sa: तस्मिन् समिद्धे पतिताः शलभा इव ते सुताः। तान् वै शराग्निनिर्दग्धान्न त्वं शोचितुमर्हसि॥
en: Yours fell into that burning fire like insects. You should not, however, grieve for them now that they have all been burnt in the fire of the enemy's arrows.

sa: कृपेण सहितं यान्तं गुप्तं च कृतवर्मणा। को द्रौणिं युधि संरब्धं योधयेदपि देवराट्॥
en: Who is there that would, even if he be the king of the gods himself, fight Drona's son when the latter goes, accompanied by Kripa and protected by Kritavarman.

sa: इतीदमुक्तवा विससर्ज तं शरं प्रयत्नतो वर्षगणाभिपूजितम्। हतोऽसि वै फाल्गुन इत्यधिक्षिपत्रुवाच चोचैर्गिरमूर्जिता वृषः॥
en: O monarch, speaking the words, "You are killed, O Phalguna,” he, desirous of victory, with care let go that arrow which for many years he had cherished with regard.

sa: स तदासाद्य भूतं वै बिलं नुकलवद् ययौ। ततः स कुपितो द्रौणिरिन्द्रकेतुनिभां गदाम्॥
en: Worked up with anger the son of Drona then hurled a blazing mace huge as a pole set up in honor of Indra. That being devoured that mace also.

sa: पापस्य लोको निरयोऽप्रकाशो नित्यं दुःखं शोकभूयिष्ठमेवा तत्रात्मानं शोचति पापकर्मा बह्वीः समाः प्रतपन्नपतिष्ठः॥
en: The region for the sinful is hell. Darkness and constant pain are there, and it is full of sorrow. Sinking in infamy, the sinful man grieves for many years.

sa: बाह्यद्रव्यविमुक्तस्य शारीरेष्वनुगृध्यतः। यो धर्मो यत् सुखं वा स्याद् द्विषतां तत् तथास्तु नः॥२
en: May our enemies have that religious merit and that happiness which fall to the share of him, who has relinquished external objects, but whose mind still internally covets them.

sa: अधर्मं धर्म इति च योऽज्ञानादाचरेन्नरः। तं चापि प्रथितं लोके कथं राजा निवर्तयेत्॥
en: If again a man, guided by ignorance, does what is sinful in the belief that he is acting piously, how shall the king suppress that sin prevalent among men?

sa: संजय उवाच दुर्योधनो महाराज सुदर्शश्चापि ते सुतः। हतशेषौ तदा संख्ये वाजिमध्ये व्यवस्थितौ॥
en: Sanjaya said Duryodhana, O king and your Sudarsha, the only two of your children who were not killed, were at that time in the midst of the Kauravas cavalry.

sa: न त्वं हन्ता च भीमोऽयं नार्जुनो न यमावपि। कालः पर्यायधर्मेण प्राणानादत्त देहिनाम्॥
en: You have not been their slayer, nor this Bhima, nor Arjuna, nor the twins. It is Time that took away their lives according to the great law of change.

sa: किं नु राज्येन ते कार्यं पितॄन् भ्रातृनपश्यतः। अभिमन्युं च दुर्धर्षं द्रौपदेयांश्च भारत॥
en: What is the use of sovereignty to you, after have your seen your sires and brothers, O Bharata, and the irresistible Abhimanyu and the sons of Draupadi, thus killed.

sa: जन्मप्रभृति ते कश्चिद् वृजिनं न ददर्श ह। ज्ञातारं सर्वधर्माणां त्वां विदुः सर्वपार्थिवाः॥
en: No one, has ever marked the slightest transgression in you since your very birth. All the kings know you to be master of the sciences of morality and duty.

sa: अदण्ड्याश्चैव ते पुत्र विप्राश्च ददतां वर। भूतमेतत् परं लोके ब्राह्मणो नाम पाण्डव॥
en: O foremost of liberal men, the Brahmanas should never be punished by you, for the Brahmana, O son of Pandu, is the foremost of human beings on the Earth.

sa: यथार्थमेव योद्धव्यं न क्रुद्ध्येत जिघांसतः॥ साधूनां तु मिथो भेदात् साधुश्चेद व्यसनी भवेत्।
en: Poisoned or barbed arrows should not be used. These are the weapons used by the wicked. One should fight fairly, without giving way to anger or desiring to kill.

sa: ततो दुर्योधनो राजा दृष्ट्वा स्वबलसंक्षयम्। हतशेषान् समानीय क्रुद्धो रथगणान् बहून्॥ कुञ्जरांश्च हयांश्चैव पादातांश्च समन्ततः। उवाच सहितान् सर्वान् धार्तराष्ट्र इदं वचः॥ समासाद्य रणे सर्वान् पाण्डवान् ससुहृद्गणान्। पाञ्चाल्यं चापि सबलं हत्वा शघ्रं न्यवर्तत॥
en: Beholding that onslaugh of his own soldiers. O lord, King Duryodhana was filled with rage. Collecting the residue of his cars which was still many hundreds in number, as also his elephants and horse and foot, O scorcher of foes, your son said to those warriors:-"Meeting all the Pandavas with their friends and allies, in this battle and the Panchala prince also with his own army and killing them speedily turn back from the field.

sa: सर्ववर्णः सदा रक्ष्यं ब्रह्मस्वं ब्राह्मणा यथा। न स्थेयं विषये तेन योऽपकुर्याद् द्विजातिषु॥
en: All the cases should protect the wealth of a Brahmana as well as his body and life. The person that offends against Brahmanas should be banished from the kingdom.

sa: तथा हि त्वरमाणेन त्वया कार्यं हितं मम्। यत्नं कुरु महाप्राज्ञ यथा रक्षाऽऽवयोर्भवेत्॥
en: You should do quickly what is for my wellbeing. O you of great wisdom, do you try a little so that good may be done to both of us.

sa: प्राज्ञः शूरो धनस्थश्च स्वामी धार्मिक एव च। तपस्वी सत्यवादी च बुद्धिमांश्चापि रक्षति॥
en: He who is wise, or brave or rich. a influential, or righteous, or engaged in penances or truthful in speech, or endued with intelligence, assists in protecting his fellowsubjects,

sa: रक्षितात्मा च यो राजा रक्ष्यान् यश्चानुरक्षति। प्रजाश्च तस्य वर्धन्ते ध्रुवं च महदश्नुते॥
en: That king, who, first protecting his own self, protects others worthy of protection, feels the satisfaction of seeing his subjects prosper. Such a king succeeds also in acquiring greatness.

sa: बले वीर्यं च सदृशस्तेजसा चैव तेऽनघ। रूपेण च तथाप्यर्थं शेते भुवि निपातितः॥
en: In power, energy, and prowess, he has your equal, O sinless one! He resembled you very much in beauty. Yet he sleeps on the ground, killed by the enemy.

sa: इत्युक्तवान् गुरुः पुत्रं द्रोणः पश्चादयोक्तवान्। न त्वं जातु सतां मार्गे स्थातेति पुरुषर्षभ॥
en: Thus the preceptor Drona spoke to his son. Some time after he again spoke, saying,-O foremost of men, it seems, you will not, follow the path of the righteous.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच तस्यां रात्र्यां व्यतीतायां धृष्टद्युम्नस्य सारथिः। शशंस धर्मराजाय सौप्तिके कदनं कृतम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said “After the termination of the night, the driver of Dhrishtadyumna's car communicated to king Yudhishthira the great slaughter that had been caused during the hour of sleep.

sa: संजय उवाच स मेधनिनदो हर्षानिनदनिव गोवृषः। आजुहाव तदा पार्थं युद्धाय युधि वीर्यवान्॥
en: Sanjaya said Having a voice deep like a cloud, Duryodhana then roared from joy like a bull. Possessed of great energy, he challenged the son of Pritha to battle.

sa: यो विश्वसिति मित्रेषु न विश्वसिति शत्रुषु। अर्थयुक्तिमविज्ञाय यः प्रीतौ कुरुते मनः॥ मित्रे वा यदि वा शत्रौ तस्यापि चलिता मतिः।
en: He, who blindly places confidence in friends and always treats enemies mistrustfully without paying any heed to considerations of policy, finds his life unsafe. He, who, neglecting all considerations of policy, seeks either friends or foes, is regarded as a person whose understanding has been unhinged.

sa: धर्मं च मत्तो गृह्णीष्व सात्वतं नाम नामतः। तेन सृष्टं कृतयुगं स्थापयस्व यथाविधि॥
en: Do you receive also from me this excellent religion known by the name of Satvata. Helped by that religion do you create the golden age and ordain it duly.

sa: पाणिबन्धं स्वयं कृत्वा सह धर्ममुपेत्य च। यदा यास्यन्ति पुरुषाः स्त्रियो नार्हन्ति वाच्यताम्॥
en: If men, after taking wives and pledging themselves to acquire religious merit without being dissociated from them, seek union with other people's wives, they then cease to deserve respect.

sa: नास्ति मातृसमा छाया नास्ति मातृसमा गतिः। नास्ति मातृसमं त्राणं नास्ति मातृसमा प्रिया॥
en: There is no shelter like the mother. There is no refuge like the mother. There is no defence like the mother. There is no one dearer than the mother.

sa: भीष्म उवाच यथा शरीरं न ग्लायेन्येयान्मृत्युवशं यथा। तथा कर्मसु वर्तेत समर्थो धर्ममाचरेत्॥
en: Bhishma said One should, when able, acquire merit and act in such a way that his body may not languish and suffer pain, and that death may not come.

sa: अद्यैव कुरु यच्छ्यो मा त्वां कालोऽत्यगान्महान्। को हि जानाति कस्याद्य मृत्युकालो भविष्यति॥
en: Do to-day what is for your behoof! See that Death, who is irresistible, may not overcome you. Who knows that Death will not come to one this very day.

sa: इदं श्रेय इदं ब्रह्म इदं हितमनुत्तमम्। लोकान् संचिन्त्य मनसा ततः शास्त्रं प्रचक्रिरे॥
en: This is good, This is Brahma,—-This is highly beneficial,-reflecting thus in their minds, those Rishis created the worlds, and the science of morality and duty that governs those worlds.

sa: ये च च्छिन्दन्ति वृषणान् ये च भिन्दन्ति नस्तकान्। वहन्ति महतो भारान् बधन्ति दमयन्ति च॥ हत्वा सत्त्वानि खादन्ति तान् कथं न विगर्हसे। मानुषा मानुषानेव दासभावेन भुञ्जते॥ वधबन्धनिरोधेन कारयन्ति दिवानिशम्। आत्मनश्चापि जानाति यद् दुःखं वधबन्धने॥
en: Why do you not destroy them who emasculate bulls and bore their noses and make them bear heavy loads and bind them and put them under various sorts of restraint, and who eat the flesh of living creatures after killing them. Men are seen to acquire men as slaves, and by beating, by binding, and by otherwise subjugating them, make them work day and night. These people are not ignorant of the pain that is caused by beating and chains.

sa: तत् सर्वं भगवानेव इति मे निश्चिता मतिः। नमस्ते भगवन् देव नमस्ते भक्तवत्सल॥
en: You are endued with supreme power. This is my certain conclusion. I bow to you, O powerful and illustrious one, O you who are kind to all your worshippers.

sa: अस्त्येव त्वयि शोकोऽपि हर्षश्चापि तथा त्वयि। सुखदुःखे तथा चोभे तत्र का परिवेदना॥
en: You have grief for your associate. But joy, at the same time, lives in you. Both happiness and misery live in you. Why should you then yield to grief?

sa: भीष्म उवाच शृणु राजन् ज्वरस्येमं सम्भवं लोकविश्रुतम्। विस्तरं चास्य वक्ष्यामि यादृशश्चैव भारत॥
en: Listen, O king, to the origin, known all over the world, of Fever! I shall describe fully this topic, fully explaining how Fever first came into existence, O Bharata.

sa: अथ चेमे महाप्राज्ञाः शेरते हि गतासवः। मृता इति च शब्दोऽयं वर्तत्येषु गतासुषु॥
en: Highly wise, they are now lying dead on the naked earth. about them, however, that are deprived of life, the word that is used is that they are dead.

sa: गौश्च प्रतिग्रहीता च दाता चैव समं यदा। इहैव विलयं यान्ति कुतस्तेषां समागमः॥
en: The taker of the cow and the giver are both equally subject to death. Both of them meet with destruction in this world. How then will they meet again?

sa: एवमेतत् पठन्ते य एकभक्त्या तु शङ्करम्। या गतिः सांख्ययोगानां व्रजन्त्येतां गतिं तदा॥
en: He who recites this hymn with rapt devotion to Shankara, succeeds in acquiring that high end which is theirs who are devoted to the doctrines of the Sankhya philosophy.

sa: तपसा तदवाप्नोति यद् भूत्वा सृजते जगत्। तद् भूतश्च ततः सर्वभूतानां भवति प्रभुः॥
en: By penance one acquires to that portion, by becoming which one creates the universe. By penance one becomes that by which one becomes the powerful master of all things.

sa: कथं चाप्युशना प्राप शुक्रत्वममरद्युतिः। ऋद्धिं च स कथं प्राप्तः सर्वमेतद् वदस्व मे॥
en: Endued with the effulgence of an immortal, why did Ushanas obtain the name of Shukra? How also did he acquire such superior excellence? Tell me all about these things.

sa: वायोरपि गुणं स्पर्शमाकाशं ग्रसते यदा। प्रशाम्यति तदा वायुः खं तु तिष्ठति नादवत्॥
en: Then Space takes the attribute, viz., sound, of Wind, upon which the latter is extinguished and enters into a state of existence resembling that of unheard or unuttered sound.

sa: भीष्म उवाच अत्र ते वर्तयिष्येऽहमितिहासं पुरातनम्। जगौ यद् भगवान् व्यासः पुत्राय परिपृच्छते॥
en: Bhishma said Regarding it I shall recite to you an old narrative of what the divine Vyasa said to his son Shuka when the latter had asked the former.

sa: न गुणा विदुरात्मानं स गुणान् वेत्ति सर्वशः। परिद्रष्टा गुणानां तु संसृष्टान्मन्यते तथा॥
en: The qualities do not know the Soul, but the Soul knows them all. The Soul is the spectator of the qualities and consider them all as emanating from itself.

sa: निन्दत्सु च समा नित्यं प्रशंसत्सु च देवल। निहुवन्ति च ये तेषां समयं सुकृतं च यत्॥ उक्ताश्च न वदिष्यन्ति वक्तारमहिते हितम्। प्रतिहन्तुं न चेच्छन्ति हन्तारं वै मनीषिणः॥
en: They, O Devala, who treat equally those who praise them and those who blame them, they who conceal their own vows and good acts, they who never indulge in vilifications, they who never say even what is good when it is calculated to injure (instead of producing any benefit), they who do not desire to retaliate injury are said to be wise men.

sa: नातः परं हि नारीणां विद्यते च कदाचन॥ यथा पुरुषसंसर्गः परमेतद्धि नः फलम्।
en: There is no other pleasure more agreeable to women. Indeed, union with a person of the opposite sex is the most desirable object of joy that we can get.

sa: हित्वा गुणमयं सर्वं कर्म हित्वा शुभाशुभम्। उभे सत्यानृते त्यक्त्वा एवं भवति निर्गुणः॥
en: By renouncing the consciousness of body and the senses, by renouncing all acts good and bad, by renouncing both truth and falsehood, one succeeds in divesting oneself of qualities.

sa: मातरं पितरं केचिच्छुश्रूषन्तो दिवं गताः। अहिंसया परे स्वर्ग सत्येन च तथा परे॥
en: Some, by waiting dutifully upon their mothers and fathers, have gone to heaven. Some have ascended to heaven by practising the duty of mercy, and some by practising Truth.

sa: भीष्म उवाच पुत्रदारैः सुखैश्चैव वियुक्तस्य धनेन वा। मग्नस्य व्यसने कृच्छ्रे धृतिः श्रेयस्करी नृप॥ धैर्येण युक्तस्य सत: शरीरं न विशीर्यते।
en: 'Fortitude is of the greatest good, O king, for one who has been deprived of sons and wives and pleasures of every sort and wealth, and who has been plunged into dire distress. The body is never emaciated of one who is always endued with fortitude.

sa: भूमिरेव मनुष्येषु धारिणी भूतभाविनी। सा ते पादं तितिक्षेत समर्था हीति मे मतिः॥
en: Amongst men, the Earth, that mother of all things, bears them all. She shall bear a fourth part of yourself. I think she has the strength to do so.

sa: वासुदेव उवाच न गतिः कर्मणां शक्या वेत्तुमीशस्य तत्त्वतः। हिरण्यगर्भप्रमुखा देवाः सेन्द्रा महर्षयः॥
en: Vasudeva said The very gods with Indra, and the Grandfather Brahman numbering among them, and the great Rishis also, cannot understand the course of Mahadeva's deeds truly and full.

sa: पुलाका इव धान्येषु पूत्यण्डा इव पक्षिषु। तद्विधास्ते मनुष्येषु येषां धर्मो न कारणम्॥
en: Those who are not pious should not be counted among men even as grains without kennel are not counted among grain and a6 cockroaches are not counted among birds.

sa: भीष्म उवाच ब्रह्मचर्यात् परं तात मधुमांसस्य वर्जनम्। मर्यादायां स्थितो धर्मः शमश्चैवास्य लक्षणम्॥
en: Bhishma said I tell you, O son, that abstention from honey and meat is even superior to Brahmacharya. Virtue lies within boundaries. The best mark of virtue is Renunciation.

sa: प्रहरेन्न नरेन्द्रेषु न हन्याद् गां तथैव च। भ्रूणहत्यासमं चैव उभयं यो निषेवते॥
en: One should never do an act of violence to the king's body. Nor should one ever strike a cow. Both these offences are equal to the sin of foeticide.

sa: मुनिश्च स्यात् सदा विप्रो दैवतं च सदा भवेत्। कुटुम्बिको धर्मकामः सदास्वप्नश्च भारत॥
en: Such a Brahman will become a Muni always, a deity, and sleepless forever, and one engaged in the pursuit of virtue only, even if he lives in a family.

sa: ये भागा रक्षसां प्राप्तास्त उक्ता भरतर्षभ। अत ऊर्ध्वं विसर्गस्य परीक्षां ब्राह्मणे शृणु॥
en: I have described to you the dues of the Rakshasas. Listen now to me as I put down the rules for determining the Brahmana who is worthy of gifts.

sa: भीष्म उवाच स पल्या वचनं श्रुत्वा धर्मयुक्तिसमन्वितम्। हर्षेण महता युक्तो वाक्यं व्याकुललोचनः॥
en: Bhishma said Hearing these words of morality and reason spoken by his wife, the pigeon was filled with great delight and his eyes were bathed in tears of joy.

sa: वृक्षमूलेऽपि दयिता यस्य तिष्ठति तद् गृहम्। प्रासादोऽपि तया हीनः कान्तार इति निश्चितम्॥
en: Even the food of a tree is one's home, if he lived there with his wife as a companion. Without one's wife, even a palace is a desolate forest.

sa: भीष्म उवाच संधेयान् पुरुषान् राजन्नसंधेयांश्च तत्त्वतः। वदतो मे निबोध त्वं निखिलेन युधिष्ठिर॥
en: Bhishma said Hear, O Yudhishthira, as I speak to you fully of those men with whom friendships may be contracted and those with whom friendships should not be made.

sa: भीष्म उवाच तमसा हि प्रतिच्छन्नं विभ्रान्तमिव चातुरम्। पुनः प्रशमयन् वाक्यैः कविः पञ्चशिखोऽब्रवीत्॥
en: Bhishma said Seeing the king enveloped in thick darkness, stupefied by error, and become helpless, the learned Panchashikha put his mind at rest by once more addressing him thus.

sa: अहिरेव ाहेः पादान् पश्यतीति हि नः श्रुतम्। तद्वन्मूर्तिषु मूर्तिस्थं ज्ञेयं ज्ञानेन पश्यति॥
en: It is heard that only a snake can see a snake's legs. Likewise one sees, through Knowledge, the Soul encased in subtle form and living within the gross body.

sa: पात्रं त्वतिथिमासाद्य शीलाढ्यं यो न पूजयेत्। स दत्त्वा दुष्कृतं तस्मै पुण्यमादाय गच्छति॥
en: Whenever a deserving guest seeks the hospitality of a householder and is not respected by him, he takes away all the virtues of the latter giving him his sins.

sa: नारद उवाच राजानं पौरवं वीरं मृतं सृञ्जय शुश्रुम। सहस्रं यः सहस्राणां श्वेतानश्वानवासृजत्॥
en: Narada said O Srinjaya, we also heard of the death of the heroic king Paurava, who gave away a thousand times thousand horses that were all white in colour.

sa: संजय उवाच इत्युक्तवति गाङ्गेये अभिवाद्योपमन्त्र्य च। राधेयो रथमारुह्य प्रायात् तव सुतं प्रति॥
en: Sanjaya said When Ganga's son had thus spoken, the son of Radha, having saluted and propitiated the former, mounted his chariot and drove towards the pavilion of your son.

sa: तं च दीप्तं शरं घोरमायान्तं मृत्युमात्मनः। चिच्छेदं शरवृष्टिं च भारद्वाजे मुमोच ह॥
en: He cut down that terrible and blazing arrow which was rushing towards him like his own death. He then poured a shower of arrows on the son of Bharadvaja.

sa: स कर्णं कर्णिना कर्णे पीतेन च शितेन च। फाल्गुनिर्द्विषतां मध्ये विव्याध परमेषुणा॥
en: Then in the very midst of the hostile troops, the son of Phalguna pierced Karna in one of his ears with an excellent barbed arrows, carefully tempered and whetted.

sa: तौ तत्रोपगतौ राजन् शरदीप्तौ महाबलौ।॥ अयुध्येतां महात्मानौ यथोभौ वृत्रवासवौ। अन्योन्यं तु महाराज परस्परवधैषिणौ॥ निगृह्य कार्मुकं श्वेतो भीष्मं विव्याध सप्तभिः।
en: O king! those two mighty and great warriors, both blazing with their arrows, fought with each other like Vritra and Vasava in the days of yore, both eager to kill each other. Having drawn his bow to the fullest stretch, Shveta wounded Bhishma with seven arrows.

sa: यदहन्यत संग्रामे दैवमत्र पुरातनम्॥ नैतादृशं समुद्योगं दृष्टवन्तो हि मानुषाः। ऋषयो वा महाभागाः पुराणा भुवि संजय॥ ईदृशोऽपि बलौघस्तु संयुक्तः शस्त्रसम्पदा।
en: If that army be still slaughtered in battle, it is indeed due to predestined Fate. Neither man, nor illustrious and ancient sages, O Sanjaya, ever saw on earth such extensive preparations for battle. That such a large army well-supplied with the implements and sinews of war.

sa: न मे पार्थास्ति कर्तव्यं त्रिषु लोकेषु किंचन। नानवाप्तमवाप्तव्यं वर्त एव च कर्मणि॥
en: There is, O Partha, nothing to do for Me in the three worlds. I have nothing to acquire which has not been (already) acquired; still I do perform actions.

sa: येन सर्वान् महावीर्यान् प्रशासिष्यसि कौरव। न च रामः क्षयं गन्ता तेनास्त्रेण नराधिप॥
en: By this weapon, by which O son of Kuru, you will hold in check all persons of mighty energy, Rama will not be killed outright, O king of men.

sa: हृष्टा वाचस्तथा सत्त्वं योधानां यत्र भारत। न म्लायन्ति सजश्चैव ते तरन्ति रणोदधिम्॥
en: Those, that send forth cheerful shouts, o descendant of Bharata, those warriors, whose courage is not damped and whose garlands do not fade, always cross the ocean of battle.

sa: श्रीभगवानुवाच मय्यासक्तमनाः पार्थ योगं युञ्जन् मदाश्रयः। असंशयं समग्रं मां यथा ज्ञास्यसि तच्छृणु॥
en: The great One said "Now hear, O Partha, how you can without doubt, know Me fully, by fixing your mind on Me, practicing yoga, and taking refuge in Me.

sa: स सप्तभिः सप्त शरप्रवेकान् संवार्य भूरिश्रवसा विसृष्टान्। शितेन दुर्योधनबाहुमुक्तं क्षुरेण तत् तोमरमुन्ममाथ॥
en: Thereupon baffling the seven javelins with seven arrows, which were as fleet as arrows, shot by Bhurishrava, Arjuna cut off with his sharp arrow the lance hurled by Duryodhana.

sa: हा वीर दृष्टो नष्टश्च घनं स्वप्न इवासि मे। अहो ह्यनित्यं मानुष्यं जलबुद्बुदचञ्चलम्॥
en: Alas, O hero, you were like a hoard of treasure to me, seen and lost in dream. Alas! everything human is as transitory as even a bubble of water!

sa: मनसैव हि भूतानि धातैव कुरुते वशे। यद् ब्रवीषि च वार्ष्णेय धार्तराष्ट्रानहं रणे॥
en: By the force of the mind alone, does the Creator bring all creatures under his control. You too, O scion of the Vrishni race, said at the time namely.

sa: संजय उवाच ततस्ते पार्थिवाः सर्वे जग्मुः स्वानालयान् पुनः। तूष्णीभूते महाराज भीष्मे शान्तनुन्दने॥
en: Sanjaya said After Bhishma the son of Shantanu had ceased speaking, O mighty monarch, all the rulers of earth that had come there, went back to their respective quarters.

sa: संजय उवाच वयं तु प्रवरं हत्वा तेषां तैः शरपीडिताः। निवेशायाभ्युपायामः सायाह्ने रुधिरोक्षिताः॥
en: Sanjaya said Thus having slain one of their best warriors and having been afflicted with their shafts and covered with blood, we returned to our quarters in the evening.

sa: आहोस्विद् धर्मराजस्य द्वेष्टा तस्य न विद्यते। यदीच्छसि त्वं जीवन्तं कुलं रक्षसि चात्मनः॥
en: It is wonderful that the virtuous king Yudhishthira should have none deadly inimical to him. As you desire him to live, either you intend to preserve your own race.

sa: अभिनच्च पदात्योघांस्त्वदीयानेव सर्वशः। एवमेकेन तां सेना सौभद्रेण शितैः शरैः॥ भृशं विप्रहतां दृष्ट्वा स्कन्देनेवासुरी चमूम्। त्वदीयास्तव पुत्राश्च वीक्षमाणा दिशो दश॥
en: Began to break through your infantry divisions on all sides. Thus the beholding the army mangled with sharp arrows of the singlehanded son of Subhadra like the army of the Asuras mangled by Skanda, your sons looked vacantly at all the ten points of the compass.

sa: किमर्थे च नरव्याघ्र न वधं तस्य काक्षसे। नाशंससि क्रियामेतां मत्तो दुर्योधन ध्रुवम्॥
en: Why, O foremost of men, do you not desire his slaughter? For what reason do you not allude to his death? Surely ODuryodhana, you are not wanting in policy.

sa: चित्रसेनादयश्चैव पुत्रास्तव विशाम्पते। पञ्चभिः पञ्चभिस्तूर्णं संयुगे निशितैः शरैः॥ आजजुरर्जुनं संख्ये भीमसेनं च मारिष। तौ तत्र रथिनां श्रेष्ठौ कौन्तेयौ भरतर्षभौ॥
en: Then, O ruler of men, your sons headed by Chitrasena, in that battle quickly pierced Bhima and Arjuna, O sire, each shooting five arrows of exceeding sharpness. Then these two foremost of car-warriors the two illustrious descendants of the Bharata race, viz., the sons of Kunti.

sa: अथवा पितरं मूढं यो मेऽकार्षीत् स्वयंवरम्। मयाऽयं स्वकृतो दोषो याऽहं भीष्मरथात् तदा॥
en: Or that foolish father who made arrangements for the selection of a husband by myself. It was a fault of mine own that at that time from Bhishma's chariot,

sa: महर्षयः सप्त पूर्वे चत्वारो मनवस्तथा। मद्भावा मानसा जाता येषां लोक इमाः प्रजाः॥
en: The seven great Rishis, and also the four ancient Manus, pertaining my nature, were all born from my mind, (by My mere thinking). From them are all things born.

sa: य इच्छसि जगत् सर्वं नश्यमानं नृशंसवत्। अभयं सर्वभूतेभ्यो दाता त्वमिति मे मतिः॥
en: Do you desire like an inhuman being to destroy the entire world, on the contrary in my opinion you should rather keep all living creatures in safety. on my

sa: भूमौ च जायते सर्वं भूमौ सर्वं विनश्यति। भूमिः प्रतिष्ठा भूतानां भूमिरेव सनातनम्॥
en: Every thing rises from the earth and when destroyed every thing goes into her. The earth is the stay and the refuge of all creatures. The earth is eternal.

sa: एकस्तु धार्तराष्ट्रेभ्यः पाण्डवान् यः समाश्रितः। तं बृहन्तो महाकाया युयुत्सुमवहन् रणे॥ पलालकाण्डवर्णास्तु वार्धक्षेमि तरस्विनम्। ऊहुः सुतुमुले युद्धे हयाः कृष्णाः स्वलंकृताः॥
en: Huge-bodied steeds bore to battle Yuyutsu, who alone, among the sons of Dhritarashtra, had sided with the Pandavas, (deserting his own brothers). Steeds, plump, decked with golden caparisons and of the hue of the stalk of paddy, bore to that dreadful battle, Vardhakshemi of great activity.

sa: शराहता भिन्नदेहा बद्धयोक्त्रा हयोत्तमाः। युगानि पर्यकर्षन्त तत्र तत्र स्म भारत॥ अदृश्यन्त ससूताश्च साश्वाः सरथयोधिनः। एकेन बलिना राजन् वारणेन विमर्दिताः॥
en: O Bharata, wounded with arrows with their bodies mangled, and their harnesses on, excellent steeds ran there dragging the caryokes after them. Many warriors, O king, with their cars, horses and drivers were seen slain in that battle by a single elephants possessed of great strength.

sa: वासुदेव उवाच पातयैनं रथात् पार्थ क्षत्रियं युद्धदुर्मदम्। नाहत्वा युधि गाङ्गेयं विजयस्ते भविष्यति॥
en: Vasudeva said Overthrow, O son of Pritha, this Kshatriya ever invincible in battle, from his car. Without slaying Ganga's son in battle you can not hope to win victory.

sa: एतस्मात् कारणाद् राजन् स्थूणो न त्वाद्य सर्पति। श्रुत्वा कुरु यथान्यायं विमानमिह तिष्ठताम्॥
en: It is for this reason, O king, that Sthuna does not approach you today. Having (now) heard (this) do as it seems proper. “Let the car be stopped here."

sa: युयुधाते रणे वीरौ सौभद्रकुरुपुङ्गवौ॥ सात्यकिं रभसं युद्धे द्रौणिर्ब्राह्मणपुङ्गवः। आजघानोरसि क्रुद्धो नाराचेन परंतपः॥
en: Then that afflicter of foes, viz., Drona's son that foremost of Brahmanas encountering Satyaki in battle and waxing worth, pierced the latter on the breast with a long shaft.

sa: ततो गत्वा तु सा गङ्गां महामेरुं च केवलम्। तस्थौ चाश्मेव निश्चेष्टा प्राणायामपरायणा॥
en: Repairing next to the Ganga and thence to the great Meru, she remained inert like a block of stone, devoting herself in the practice of Pranayama (suspension of breaths).

sa: न हि ते संयुगे पीडां शक्तः कर्तुं महाबलः। तस्मादद्य महाबाहो यत्नाद् भीष्ममभिद्रव॥
en: O mighty-armed hero, Bhishma will not be able to cause pain to you in battle. Therefore, O mighty hero, do you now assail Bhishma putting forth all your energies.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच अक्षौहिण्यो दशैका च व्यूढा दृष्ट्वा युधिष्ठिरः। कथमल्पेन सैन्येन प्रत्यव्यूहत पाण्डवः॥
en: Dhritarashtra said Having seen our eleven Akshauhinis placed in battle array, how did Yudhishthira the son of Pandu, make his counter-array with his troops which were smaller than ours?

sa: धरणी न स पस्पर्श शरसंधैः समावृतः॥ रथाद् भीष्मे शरतल्पे महेष्वासं शयानं पुरुषर्षभम्।
en: Covered closely with arrows he did not then touch the earth's surface. Then as that mighty bowman, that foremost of all male beings lay prostrate on his arrows bed,

sa: ननर्द बहुधा राजन् हृष्टश्चासीत् परंतपः। शङ्ख दध्मौ च समरे सिंहनादं ननाद च॥
en: O chastiser of foes, O king. He sent forth many loud shouts and filled all his troops with delight. He blew his conch and uttered a lion like roar.

sa: भीष्म उवाच एवमुक्तः स पितृभिः पितॄन् रामोऽब्रवीदिदम्। नाहं युधि निवर्तेयमिति मे व्रतमाहितम्॥
en: Bhishma said Being thus spoken by his ancestors, Rama thus spoken to them, “I will not desist from the combat, this is the vow I have taken upon myself.

sa: अम्बां चैवाम्बिकां चैव तथैवाम्बालिकामपि॥ राजानश्च समाहूताः पृथिव्यां भरतर्षभ। अम्बा ज्येष्ठाभवत् तासामम्बिकात्वथ मध्यमा॥
en: They were Amba, Ambika, and Ambalika and all the rulers of the earth were invited, O foremost of the Bharatas. Amba was the elder among them, Ambika the second,

sa: तस्मिन् हते हतं मन्ये पाण्डवानां महद् बलम्। तथेति च वचस्तस्य परिगृह्य महारथाः॥
en: If he be slain, I may then consider the whole host of the Pandavas as nothing more than slain.” Then accepting his words by saying 'yea', the mighty car-warriors,

sa: समः किरीटिना संख्ये वीर्येण च बलेन च। सत्यजित् सत्यसंधेन द्रोणेन निहतो युधि॥
en: Satyajit, who was like Kiritin (Arjuna, decked in diadem) fighting in the field, both in prowess and strength, was slain in battle by Drona, who was of sure aim.

sa: अश्वत्थामेति हि गजः ख्यातो नाम्ना हतोऽभवत्। कृत्वा मनसि तं भीमो मिथ्या व्याहृतवांस्तदा॥
en: The elephant known by the name of Ashvatthaman having been slain, Bhima spoke of Ashvatthainan's death. Knowing the true fact in his mind, Bhima then spoke what was false.

sa: नैव सूर्यप्रभा राजन् न दिशः प्रदिशस्तथा॥ प्राज्ञासिष्म वयं ते वा शरैमुक्तैः सहस्रशः।
en: On account of those thousands of arrows, O king, neither the rays of the sun nor the cardinal quarters could be seen either by ourselves or by the enemy.

sa: स शिष्यः प्राप्य तत् सर्वं सविशेषं च संजया शूरः शारद्वतीपुत्रः संख्ये द्रोणादनन्तरः॥
en: O Sanjaya, the heroic son of Saradvata's daughter, being the disciple of his own sire has obtained all that knowledge in every detail and has become a second Drona.

sa: स संगृह्य स्वयं वाहान् कृष्णौ प्राच्छादयच्छरैः। तत्राद्भुतमपश्याम द्रौणेराशु पराक्रमम्॥ प्रायच्छत्तुरगान् यच्च फाल्गुनं चाप्ययोधयत्। यदस्य समरे राजन् सर्वे योधा अपूजयन्॥
en: Then himself taking up the reins of horses Drona's son covered Krishna and Arjuna with arrows. He saw a wonderful power in him then. He simultaneously drove his horses and fought with Phalguna. It was spoken highly of by all the warriors in battle, O king.

sa: अथैनमब्रवीद् राजन् भगवान् देवसत्तमः। भविता त्वत्समो नान्यः कश्चिद् युधि नरः क्वचित्।। ३३
en: Thereupon that foremost of all gods, that possessor of the six divine qualities said unto him, O king, “No man shall ever be a match for you in battle.

sa: मकरस्य तु तुण्डे वै कर्णो राजन् व्यवस्थितः। नेत्राभ्यां शकुनिः शूर उलूकश्च महारथः॥
en: O king, Karna placed himself in the tip of the beak of that Makara; and the heroic Shakuni and the great car-warrior Uluka were stationed in both the eyes.

sa: विकोशौ चाप्यसी कृत्वा समरे तौ विचेरतुः। चरन्तौ विविधान् मार्गान् मण्डलानि च भागशः॥
en: And drawing out their swords out of their scabbards, they appeared beautiful on the field of battle. They moved in various motions and described in their montions, various circles.

sa: इति कृष्णवचः श्रुत्वा धर्मराजौ युधिष्ठिरः। ससम्भ्रमं हृषीकेशमुत्थाप्य प्रणतं तदा॥ कृताञ्जलिस्ततो वाक्यमुवाचानन्तरं वचः।
en: Upon this Yudhishthira, the foremost of the righteous, hastened to raise the prostrate Hrishikesha with due honor. Then, folding his hands together, he said unto him these opportune words-

sa: रथं सोपस्करं छत्रं शक्तिं खङ्गं गदां ध्वजम्॥ भल्लैचिच्छेद दशभिः पुत्रस्य तव पार्षतः।
en: And with remaining ten shafts the son of Prishata cut-off the royal umbrella, the spear, the sword, the mace, the car with Upaskara and the flag of your son.

sa: कर्ण उवाच उक्तमेतन्मया पूर्वं गान्धारे तव संनिधौ। जेष्यामि पाण्डवान् सर्वान् सपुत्रान् सजनार्दनान्॥४०
en: Karna said O son of Gandhari, this was already told by me before you, namely that I would subdue all the Pandavas with their sons and with Janardana, too.

sa: दिष्ट्यासि राजन् न हतो दिष्ट्या न ग्रहणं गतः। परिसान्त्वय बीभत्सुं जयमाशाधि चानघ॥
en: O king, it was very fortunate that you were not slain or captured. O holy one, do now console your Vibhatsu and bless him that he may attain victory."

sa: भूत्वा हि विपुला सेना तावकानां परैः सह। अन्योन्यं समरं प्राप्य किंचिच्छेषा विशाम्पते॥
en: O sovereign, at first your own troops and those of the hostile party were a legion, but being engaged in fight there have been left but a small remnant.

sa: अयं च प्रत्ययः कर्णे शक्तिशामितविक्रमा। किमर्थं सूतपुत्रेण न मुक्ता फाल्गुने तु सा॥
en: O Janardana, it had been Karna's firm resolve that he would hurl that dart of infinite energy at Phalguna. Why then did he not hurt if at him actually.

sa: मयूखिनः परिघा लोहबद्धा गदाश्चित्राः शितधाराश्च शूलाः। गुयॊ गदा हेमपट्टावनद्धाः शतघ्यश्च प्रादुरासन् समन्तात्॥
en: And spiked bludgeons pouring shinning rays, charming maces made of iron, long lances of keen points, heavy maces adorned with gold and entwined with strings and Shataghnis all around.

sa: संजय उवाच निहत्यालायुधं रक्षः प्रहृष्टात्मा घटोत्कचः। ननाद विविधान् नादान् वाहिन्याः प्रमुखे तव॥
en: Sanjaya said Having slain the Rakshasa Alayudha Ghatotkacha was greatly delighted; and then standing at the very van of the troops he began to utter diverse kinds of roars.

sa: चित्रायुधश्चित्रवर्मा समरे चित्रयोधिनः। तानापतत एवाशु भीमसेनो महारथः॥ एकैकेन शरेणाजौ पातयामास ते सुतान्। ते हता न्यपतन् भूमौ वातरुग्णा इव दुमाः॥
en: Chitrayudha and Chitravarman, all versed in various modes of warfare. Then the mighty car-warrior Bhimasena slew all your sons with a single arrows, as they were quickly proceeding against him. Slain they fell down on the earth like trees broken by the vehemence of the tempest.

sa: संजय उवाच उत्थितः स तु शैनेया विमुक्तः सौमदत्तिना। खङ्गमादाय चिच्छित्सुः शिरस्तस्य महात्मनः॥
en: Sanjaya said Liberated from the grasp of Somadatta's son, the grandson of Sini rose and with a view to cut-off the head of that illustrious hero, drew his sword.

sa: घटोत्कच उवाच अलमेवास्मि कर्णाय द्रोणायालं च भारत। अन्येषां क्षत्रियाणां च कृतास्राणां महात्मनाम्॥
en: Ghatotkacha said I am capable of encountering Karna and Drona, O Bharata and I am a match for all the other high-souled Kshatriyas accomplished in the use of weapons.

sa: ते तस्य कवच भित्वा पपुः शोणितमाहवे। आशीविषा यथा नागाभित्त्वा गां सलिलं पपुः॥
en: Those arrows, after having pierced through his armour, drank his blood in the battle; even as the snakes of virulent poison, after having penetrated the earth, drink the water.

sa: समः कर्णस्य समरे यः स कर्णस्य पश्यतः। वृषसेनो महातेजाः शीघ्रास्त्रो दृढविक्रमः॥ अभिमन्योर्वधं श्रुत्वा प्रतिज्ञामपि चात्मनः। धनंजयेन विक्रम्य गमितो यमसादनम्॥
en: The highly energetic Vrisasena of steady prowess and ready in managing the weapon-that peer of Karna in battle, was sent to the abode of Yama by Dhananjaya, who, remembering the death of his son and also his own solemn vow, showed forth his prowess in battle.

sa: शिखण्डी पञ्चविंशत्या धृष्टद्युम्नश्च सप्तभिः॥ द्रौपदेयाश्चातुःषष्ट्या सहदेवश्च सप्तभिः। नकुलश्च शतेनाजौ कर्ण विव्याध सायकैः॥
en: In that engagement Shikhandin afflicted him with twenty-five arrows, as did also Dhristadyumna with seven, the sons of Draupadi with sixty-four, Sahadeva with seven and Nakula with a hundred.

sa: संजय उवाच भीमसेनं ततो द्रोणी राजन् विव्याध पत्रिणा। परया त्वरया युक्तो दर्शयन्नस्त्रलाघवम्॥
en: Sanjaya said Thereupon, O king, the son of Drona, who was possessed of great alacrity and who showed easiness in the management of weapons, pierced Bhimasena with an arrow.

sa: न चाभिसर्तव्यमिति प्रचोदिताः परे त्वदीयाश्च तथावतस्थिरे॥ महारथौ तौ परिवार्य सर्वतः सुरासुराः शम्बरवासवाविव।
en: They assuring their troops with the words "don't give way” were surrounded by their troops and their inimical forces like Vasava and Shambara by the Gods and the Asuras.

sa: संजय उवाच विराटं सहसेनं तु द्रोणं वै द्रुतमागतम्। मद्रराजः शरौघेण च्छादयामास धन्विनम्॥
en: Sanjaya said The king of Madra, with a down-pours of arrow, covered on all sides Virata, who, accompanied by his division, was proceeding quickly for (the slaughter ot) Drona.

sa: सात्यकिरुवाच यदि मां त्वं रणे हित्वा न यास्याचार्यवद्रुतम्। धनंजयस्य पदवीं धर्मराजस्य शासनात्॥
en: Satyaki said At the command of the very virtuous king Yudhishthira, I am proceeding in the track of Dhananjaya. Good betide you, O Brahman. Let me lose no time.

sa: ततः सुतौ ते बलिनौ शूरौ दुष्कर्णदुर्मदौ। मुष्टिनाऽऽहत्य संक्रुद्धो ममर्द च ननर्द च॥
en: Then striking furiously with the blows of his fits those two heroic and powerful sons of yours, Duskama and Durmada, he crushed them (therewith) and sent forth thundering shouts.

sa: तथैव राजन् कर्णोऽपि पार्षतं शत्रुतापनम्॥ छादयामास समरे शरैराशीविषोपमैः। द्रोणशत्रुर्महेष्वासो विव्याध निशितैः शरैः॥
en: Likewise Karna too covered Prishata's son, the scorcher of his enemies with arrows resembling deadly deadly serpents. The great bowman, the enemy of Drona, struck (Karna) with sharpened arrows.

sa: न हीदानीं सहाया मे परीप्सन्त्यनुपस्कृताः। श्रेयो हि पाण्डून् मन्यन्ते न तथास्मान् महाभुज॥
en: Seeing they are not well protected our partisans are no longer desirous of supporting use. They deem the sons of Pandu are preferable to us, O mighty armed one.

sa: अर्जुन उवाच ध्रुवः एव जयः कृष्ण मम नास्त्यत्र संशयः। सर्वलोकगुरुर्यस्त्वं तुष्टोऽसि मधुसूदन॥
en: Arjuna said O Krishna, you are the destroyer of Madhu and master of all creation; and as you are kind to me my victory in this battle is sure.

sa: सिहास्यं च यथा प्राप्य न जीवन्ति मृगाः क्वचित्।। तथा कर्णमुप्राप्य न जिजीवुर्महारथाः।
en: And as a stag cam never escape from the black jaws of a lion so even those heroes, who happened to approach Karna, could not return with their lives.

sa: अथ तां देवीं राजाब्रवीत् साध्ववतर वापीसलिलमिति। सा तद्वचः श्रुत्वावतीर्य वापी न्यमज्जन्न पुनरुदमज्जत्॥
