en: Then the king thus spoke to that lady, “Cheerfully bathe in this water." Having heard his words, she got down under the water, but she did not reappear again.

sa: यस्य नार्षं प्रमाणं स्याच्छिष्टाचारच भाविनि। न वै तस्य परो लोको नायमस्तीति निश्चयः॥
en: For him, O fair lady, who disregards the words of the Rishis and does not care for the evidence of the pious, neither this world nor the next exists.

sa: स समानीय तान् सर्वान् भ्रातृनित्यब्रवीद् वचः। द्रौपद्या सहितान् काले संस्मरन् भ्रातरं जयम्॥
en: He, (Yudhishthira) once upon a time, (during his stay in the hermitage) remembering Jaya (Arjuna) and summoning all his brothers together with Draupadi 1O his presence, addressed them thus:

sa: विश्वावसोस्तु तनयाद् गीतं नृत्यं च साम च। वादित्रं च यथान्यायं प्रत्यविन्दद् यथाविधि॥
en: He has learnt from Vishvavasu's son both vocal and instrumental music and also singing and also the reciting of the Sama (Veda) as thoroughly as they should be learnt.

sa: अद्यप्रभृति युप्माकंधर्मवृद्धिर्भविष्यति। तत्र स्नात्वा नरव्याघ्र रुद्रकोट्यां नरः शुचिः॥ अश्वमेधमवाप्नोति कुलं चैव समुद्धरेत्।
en: (Saying) “From today your virtues will increase." ( foremost of men, bathing with purity in Raudrakota a inan obtains the fruits of the Ashvamedha (sacrifice) and saves his race.

sa: पुण्येन चरता राजन् भूर्दिशः खं नभस्तथा। आपूर्णमासीच्छब्देन तदप्यासीन्महाद्भुतम्॥ यत्र स्म गाथा गायन्ति मनुष्या भरतर्षभ। अन्नपानैः शुभैस्तृप्ता देशे देशे सुवर्चसः॥
en: O king, those sacred sounds filled earth, the points of the firmament, the sky and the heaven itself; and great wonders were seen. O best of Bharata race, greatly gratified with the food and the drink, men went about singing the following verse in various countries.

sa: लोमश उवाच इल्वलो नाम दैतेय आसीत् कौरवनन्दन। मणिमत्यां पुरि पुरा वातापिस्तस्य चानुजः॥
en: Lomasha said: O descendant of Kuru, there was a Daitya, named Ilvala in the days of yore in the city of Manimati. He had a younger brother, called Vatapi.

sa: मा भैस्त्वं कुरुशार्दूल श्वा सिंहं हन्तुमर्हति। शिवः पन्थाः सुनीतोऽत्र मया पूर्वतरं वृतः॥
en: "O best of the Kurus, do not be alarmed. can the dog kill the lion? I have already settled some means that is both beneficial and conformable to policy.

sa: एवं सेन्द्रं जगत् सर्वं श्वेतपर्वतसंस्थितम्। प्रहृष्टं प्रेक्षते स्कन्दं न च ग्लायति दर्शनात्॥
en: It appeared as if Indra with all the worlds had been transferred to the white mountain. All looked at Skanda with great satisfaction. None felt tired in doing so.

sa: सह त्वया हि मे वध्याः सर्वथा कृष्ण पाण्डवाः। नृपतीन् समतिक्रम्य यैरराजा त्वमर्चितः॥
en: O Krishna, the Pandavas also deserve to be killed by me with you, for they having passed over all these kings, have worshipped you who are not a king.

sa: ततः स भगवान् विष्णुस्तं वै बाणं मुमोच ह। शुष्काशनिसमाकीर्णं महोल्काभिश्च भारत॥ पांसुवर्षेण महता मेघवर्षेश्च भूतलम्। भूमिकम्पैश्च निर्घातै दैश्च विपुलैरपि॥
en: Then the exalted Vishnu (Rama) shot that arrow. O descendant of Bharata at this the whole earth was filled with sounds of thunder and burning meteors flashed through the sky. Showers of dust and rain fell on the earth, earthquakes, whirl-winds of fearful sounds convulged everything.

sa: मार्कण्डेय उवाच ततोऽग्निरुपयेमे तां शिवां प्रीतिमुदायुतः। प्रीत्या देवी समायुक्ता शुक्रं जग्राह पाणिना॥
en: Markandeya said : Then Agni being exceedingly pleased lived with her; and that lady too joyfully held intercourse with him; and she also held the seed in her hand.

sa: स भीमवचनाद् राजा कुण्डिनं प्राविशत् पुरम्।। नादयन् रथघोषेण सर्वाः स विदिशो दिशः॥
en: The king (of Ayodhya), at the request of Bhima, entered the city of Kundina, filling all the directions (the points of the horizon) with the rattle of his car.

sa: यज्ञः समाप्यतां तात सगरस्य महात्मनः। अंशुमानवमुक्तस्तु कपिलेन महात्मना॥ आजगाम हयं गृह्य यज्ञवाटं महात्मनः। सोऽभिवाद्य ततः पादौ सगरस्य महात्मनः॥ मूर्ध्नि तेनाप्युपाघ्रातस्तस्मै सर्वं न्यवेदयत्। यथा दृष्टं श्रुतं चापि सागराणां क्षयं तथा॥ तं चास्मै हयमाचष्ट यज्ञवाटमुपागतम्। तच्छ्रुत्वा सगरो राजा पुत्रजं दुःखमत्यजत्॥
en: And O child, complete the sacrifice of the illustrious Sagara.” Having been thus addressed by the illustrious Kapila, Anshuman, the highsouled one, taking the horse, came to (the sacrificial ground (of Sagara). Then saluting the feet of the illustrious Sagara who smelt his head, he told him all that had been seen and heard by him and all about the destruction of the sons of Sagara. (He also told him) that the horse had been brought to the sacrificial ground; Having heard this, the king Sagara no more grieved for his sons.

sa: करिष्यामि महाराज वचस्ते नात्र संशयः। वेगं तु मम दुर्धार्यं पतन्त्या गगनाद् भुवम्॥
en: "O great king, I shall certainly do what you say. But my force will be difficult to be withstood when I shall fall from the sky to the। earth.

sa: न केचिदीशते ब्रह्मन् स्वयंचाह्यस्य सत्तम। कर्मणां प्राक् कृतानां वै इह सिद्धिः प्रदृश्यते॥
en: O Brahmana, O excellent one, none can be the dispenser of his own destiny. The actions done in a former life is seen to produce fruits in this life.

sa: बृहदश्व उवाच हृतराज्ये नले भीमः सभार्ये च वनं गते। द्विजान् प्रस्थापयामास नलदर्शनकाझया।।।।
en: Brihadashva said : When Nala, deprived of his kingdom, turned himself to a servant with his wife, then king Bhima sent away Brahmanas, with the object of seeing Nala.

sa: शीतश्च वायुः प्रववौ प्रयाणे तस्य धीमतः। विपांसुलां महीं कुर्वन् ववर्ष च सुरेश्वरः॥
en: While that intelligent one was proceeding onwards, cool breezes began to blow and showers were poured forth by the chief of the gods, making the earth free from dusts.

sa: ततः स्नुषां स भगवान् प्रहृष्टो भृगुरब्रवीत्। वरं वृणीष्व सुभगे दाता ह्यस्मि तवेप्सितम्॥
en: Thereupon the exalted Bhrigu with a delighted heart thus spoke to nis daughter-inlaw, “O blessed girl, ask for a boon. I ain ready to grant you what you desire."

sa: पालने हि महान् धर्मः प्रजानामिह दृश्यते। न तथा दृश्यतेऽरण्ये माभूत् ते बुद्धिरीदृशी॥
en: Great merit is the fruit of protecting men in this world. Such merit can never be acquired in a forest. Therefore, let not your heart have such an inclination

sa: न मे त्वदन्या काचिद्धि प्रियास्तीत्यब्रवीः सदा। तामृतां कुरु कल्याण पुरोक्तां भारती नृप॥
en: You did always use to say, 'Except yourself, there is none dear unto me' O auspicious one! O king! prove the truth of that assertion you did make previously.

sa: शकुनिरुवाच प्रियस्ते नकुलो राजन् राजपुत्रो युधिष्ठिर। अस्माकं वशतां प्राप्तो भूयः केनेह दीव्यसे॥
en: Shakuni said O king, O Yudhisthira, the prince Nakula is dear to you. (Know) he is already under our subjection (won by us). With what will you now play?

sa: न हि दासीत्वमापन्ना कृष्णा भवितुमर्हति। अनीशेन हि राज्ञैषा पणे न्यस्तेति मे मतिः॥
en: In my opinion the slavery cannot attach to Krishna (Draupadi), as she was staked by the king (Yudhisthira) after he lost himself and ceased to be his own master.

sa: इयं च कीर्तिता कृष्णा सौबलेन पणार्थिना। एतत् सर्वं विचार्याहं मन्ये न विजितामिमाम्॥
en: The son of Subala (Shakuni), himself being desirous of a stake, prevailed upon the king to stake Krishna (Draupadi). Considering all these circumstances, I consider Draupadi as not won.

sa: ऋत्विगुवाच यजस्व जन्तुना राजंस्त्वं मया वितते क्रतौ। ततः पुत्रशतं श्रीमद् भविष्यत्यचिरेण ते॥
en: Ritvija said : O king, I shall perform this sacrifice, but you must sacrifice in it your son Jantu. Then one hundred handsome sons will be born to you.

sa: एतत् प्रत्यक्षतः सर्वं पूर्वं वृत्तं द्विजोत्तम। तस्मादिच्छाम्यहं श्रोतुं सर्वहेत्वात्मिकां कथाम्॥ अनुभूतं हि बहुशस्त्वयैकेन द्विजोत्तमा न तेऽस्त्यविदितं किंचित् सर्वलोकेषु नित्यदा॥
en: O foremost of Brahmanas, you have seen with your own eyes all that happened before. You alone have seen many things by your senses. There is nothing in all the world that is not known to you. Therefore, I eagerly desire to hear all about things.

sa: त्वन्नेत्राः सन्तु ते पुत्रा मा त्वां दीर्णाः प्रहासिषुः। तस्मादयं मद्वचनात् त्यज्यतां कुलपांसनः॥
en: Let your sons follow you as their leader. Let them not for ever be separated from you (by death). Therefore, abandon at my word this disgrace of our race.

sa: अनादिनिधनं ये त्वामनुध्यायन्ति वै नराः। तांस्त्वं पासीत्ययं वादः स गतो व्यर्थतां कथम्॥
en: The men say that you are without beginning and without end and that you save those who think of you. Why does this saying now turn to be false?

sa: विदुर उवाच निकृतस्यापि ते पुत्रैर्हते राज्ये धनेषु च। न धर्माच्चलते बुद्धिर्धर्मराजस्य धीमतः॥
en: Vidura said Through persecuted by your sons, and robbed off his kingdom and wealth, the mind of the wise Dharmaraja (Yudhisthira) has not deviated from the path of virtue.

sa: विदिता हि हरे यमिहायाताः कुरूद्वहाः। सदा हि दर्शनाकाक्षी श्रेयोऽन्वेषी च वो हरिः॥
en: Because it is known to Hari that you the perpetuators of the Kuru race have arrived here; and he is always desirous of seeing you and secks your welfare.

sa: सर्प उवाच श्रुतं विदितवेद्यस्य तव वाक्यं युधिष्ठिर। भक्षयेयमहं कस्माद् भ्रातरं ते वृकोदरम्॥
en: The snake said: O Yudhishthira, I have listened to your words. You are acquainted with what ought to be known. (Therefore) how can I (now) devour your brother Vrikodara?

sa: पूरोर्वशे हि ये पुत्रा नप्तारो वा त्विहागताः। तपसा रमयन्त्यस्मान्न च तेषां व्यतिक्रमः॥ तत् प्रसीद न मामात विसर्जयितुमर्हसि। हृच्छयेन च संतप्तं भक्तां च भज मानद॥
en: The sons and grandsons of the Puru dynasty, who have come her from their asceticism, all sport with us; and they do not incur any sin by doing it. Therefore be favourable towards me. You ought not send me away. O giver of proper respect, I am burning with desire. I am devoted to you, therefore accept me.

sa: ऋषेस्त्वया श्रुतं वाक्यं कैलास पर्वतं प्रति। बुद्ध्या प्रपश्य कौन्तेय कथं कृष्णा गमिष्यति॥
en: O son of Kunti, you have heard what the Rishi (Lomasha) has said about the Kailasa mountain. After due deliberation think, how Krishna (Draupadi) should pass through is place.

sa: वेश्मानि तान्यप्रतिमानि पश्यन् क्रीडाश्च नानादुमसंनिबद्धाः। चचारधन्वी बहुधा नरेन्द्रः सोऽस्त्रेषु यत्तः सततं किरीटी॥
en: Beholding those peerless abodes and pleasure-gardens interspersed with trees, Kiriti, the foremost of men, with a relish for arms and bow in hand, ranged at large (among) those (woods).

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवं विनिहतं संख्ये किर्मीरं रक्षसां वरम्। श्रुत्वाध्यानपरो राजा निशश्वासार्तवत् तदा॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Having thus heard of the account of the destruction of that foremost of Rakshasas, Kirinira, the king (Dhritarashtra) sighed in sorrow and became absorbed in thought.

sa: समं तेजश्च वीर्यं च ममाद्य तव चानघ। प्रीतस्तेऽहं महाबाहो पश्य मां भरतर्षभ॥
en: O mighty-armed hero, O best of the Bharata race, O sinless one, your strength and prowess are almost equal to mine. I have been pleased with you. Behold me.

sa: कोऽयं देवो भवेत् साक्षाद् रुद्रो यक्षः सुरोऽसुरः विद्यते हि गिरिश्रेष्ठे त्रिदशानां समागमः॥
en: Who is he? Is he the deity Rudra (Shiva) himself? Is he a Yaksha or a celestials or a Asura? The celestials often come to this best of mountains.

sa: स च गान्धर्वमखिलं ग्राहयामास मां नृप। तत्राहमवसं राजन् गृहीतास्त्रः सुपूजितः॥ सुखं शक्रस्य भवने सर्वकामसमन्वितः। शृण्वन् वै गीतशब्दं च तूर्यशब्दं च पुष्कलम्। पश्यंश्चाप्सरसः श्रेष्ठा नृत्यन्तीर्भरतर्षभ॥
en: It was he who taught me that entire science (of arms) known to the Gandharvas, Othe best of the Bharatas, there in the abode of Sakra I began to live happily, duly honoured, acquiring weapons, with my desires gratified, hearing songs and the clear sounds of musical instruments and witnessing the dance of the best of the Apsaras.

sa: कारुण्यात् त्वामहं वीर वारयामि निबोध मे। नातः परं त्वया शक्यं गन्तुमाश्वसिहि प्रभो॥
en: O hero, O lord, out of kindness I ask you, to desist. Listen to my words. Further up from this place you are not able to go. Therefore desist.

sa: योऽसौ सर्वान् महीपालान् धर्मेण वशमानयत्। स शान्तनुर्महातेजाः पितुस्तव पितामहः॥ प्रीयते पार्थ पार्थेन दिवि गाण्डीवधन्वना। सम्यक् चासौ महावीर्यः कुलधुर्येण पार्थिवः॥
en: O king, O Partha, he that reduced to subjection all the rulers of the earth with justice-that highly energetic and highly powerful Shantanu himself, the grandsire of your father-is in heaven fully pleased with Partha, the wielder of the Gandiva and the foremost of his race.

sa: प्रकीर्णमूर्धजा राजन् यक्षाधिपतिमब्रुवन्। गदापरिघनिस्त्रिंशतोमरप्रासयोधिनः॥ राक्षसा निहताः सर्वे तव देव पुरःसराः। प्रमृद्य तरसा शैलं मानुषेणधनेश्वर।॥ एकेन सहिताः सङ्घये रणे क्रोधवशा गणाः।। प्रवरा राक्षसेन्द्राणां यक्षाणां च नराधिप॥ शेरते निहता देव गतसत्त्वाः परासवः। लब्धशेषा वयं मुक्ता मणिमांस्ते सखा हतः॥
en: And with dishevelled hair, O king, (they) addressed the lord of the Yakshas thus, "O lord, all your foremost Rakshasas who fought with maces, swords, clubs, glances and barbed darts, have all been slaughtered. O lord of wealth, a single man crushing the mountain with great velocity have alone killed in battle all the Rakshasas of the Krodhavara clan and also the best of the Rakshasas and the Yakshas (who) lie senseless with life extinct; we only have been spared; your friend Maniman too has been killed.

sa: यां न कृष्णो न बीभत्सु भिमन्युर्न संजयाः। न चाहमभिनन्दामि न च माद्रीसुतावुभौ॥
en: Your this act is approved of neither by Krishna, nor by Vivatsu (Arjuna), nor by Abhimanyu, nor by the Srinjayas, nor by myself, nor by the sons of Madri.

sa: द्रौपद्युवाच नमोधात्रे विधाने च यौ मोहं चक्रतुस्तव। पितृपैतामहे वृत्ते वोढव्ये तेऽन्यथा मतिः॥
en: Draupadi said: I bow to Dhatri and Vidhatri who have thus bewildered my sense; you think otherwise from your father and grandfather regarding what you have got to bear.

sa: व्यास उवाच स तथेति प्रतिश्रुत्य पूजयित्वा च नारदम्। अभ्यनुज्ञाय राजर्षिययौ वाराणसी पुरीम्॥ तत्र गत्वा यथोक्तं स पुर्या द्वारे महायशाः। कुणपं स्थापयामास नारदस्य वचः स्मरन्॥
en: Vyasa said Having signified his consent to the proposal of Narada, that royal sage after duly adoring him and with his permission, went to the city of Varanasi, and having reached there, that famous prince did as he had been asked, and remembering the words of Narada, he placed a dead body at the gate of the city.

sa: अनुमान्य महाराजं तत् सदः सम्प्रसाद्य च। विप्रः प्रगल्भो मेधावी स राजानमुवाच ह॥
en: Taking the permission of the whole assembly and with its full approbation, that learned Brahmana of great intelligence, conscious of his own powers, said these words to the king.

sa: तं मया सह गत्वाद्य राजानं कुरु वर्धनम्। आपृच्छ कुरुशार्दूल गपनं द्वारका प्रति॥
en: Do you, O pride of Kuru's race, accompany me today to the king, the great advancer of the Kuru race, and sound him of my intended return to Dwraka.

sa: तव प्रसादाद् भगवन् विशोकोऽयं महीपतिः॥ यथा स्याद् भविता चाहं कुन्ती चेयं वधूस्तव।
en: Through your favour, O holy one, that will take place for which this king, myself and this daughter-in-law of yours, viz., Kunti, shall all become freed from our grief.

sa: यदा हि युक्तमात्मानं सम्यक् पश्यति देहभृत्। न तस्येहेश्वरः कश्चित् त्रैलोक्यस्यापि यः प्रभुः।।२४
en: When the bearer of a body adequately sees the Soul in Yoga, he then has no one to master him, for he then becomes the lord of three worlds.

sa: इहलोके च स प्राणी जन्मप्रभृति पार्थिव। सुकृतं कर्म वै भुक्ते धर्मस्य फलमाश्रितः॥
en: Endued with life, O king, individual soul in this world, from the moment of his birth, enjoys and suffers his own (pristine deeds), depending upon virtue (and its reverse).

sa: पुराणर्षिरचिन्त्यात्मा समीपमपराजितः। सापि बाष्पकलां वाचं निगृहाश्रूणि चैव ह॥ सुसंवीताभवद् देवी देववत् कृष्णमीयुषी।
en: Virata's daughter, checking her tears said these words in a voice chocked with grief. Covering herself properly, the pincess waited for Krishna like the celestials reverentially waiting for him.

sa: तस्मिन् विप्रे गते स्वर्ग ससुते सस्नुषे तदा॥ भार्याचतुर्थे धर्मज्ञे ततोऽहं निःसृतो बिलात्।
en: After that learned Brahmana knowing all duties, had thus ascended to the celestial region with his son, daughter-in-law, and wife numbering the fourth, I came out of my hole.

sa: इत्युक्ता सा ततः प्राह धर्माथौ नौ समौ द्विज॥ सक्तुप्रस्थचतुर्भागं गृहाणेमं प्रसीद मे।
en: Thus addressed, she answered him, saying, O twice-born one, our religions acts and wealth are united. Do you take a fourth of this barley! Indeed, be pleased with me.

sa: हत्वा वै दानवान् देवाः सर्वे सम्भूय संयुगे। तेनाभ्यजानन् हि तदा ब्राह्मणैर्निहतान् कपान्॥
en: The gods having assembled together in battle, killed many of the Danavas. They did not know at that time that it was the Brahmanas who had encompassed their destruction.

sa: भीष्म उवाच एतच्छ्रुत्वा वचस्तस्य देवर्षेरप्सरोत्तमा। प्रत्युवाच न शक्ष्यामि स्त्री सती निन्दितुं स्त्रियः॥
en: Bhishma said Hearing these words of the celestial Rishi, that foremost of Apsaras replied to him, saying I am unable being myself a woman to speak ill of women.

sa: ब्रह्मोवाच य उत्पन्नो महान् पूर्वमहंकारः स उच्यते। अहमित्येव सम्भूतो द्वितीयः सर्ग उच्यते॥
en: Brahman said That Mahat or principle of greatness who was first produced is called Egoism. When, it originated as I, it came to be called as the second creation.

sa: यं यमुद्दिश्य दीयेरन् देवं सुमनसः प्रभो। मङ्गलार्थं स तेनास्य प्रीतो भवति दैत्यप॥
en: O king of the Daityas, those celestials to whom worshippers offer flowers, O lord, uttering their names the while, become pleased with the offerers on account of their devotion.

sa: शीलवृत्ते समाज्ञाय विद्यां योनिं च कर्म च। सद्भिरेवं प्रदातव्या कन्या गुणयुते वरे॥
en: Having enquired into the conduct and nature of the person, his learning and acquirements, his birth, and his acts, good people should then confer their daughter upon accomplished bridegrooms.

sa: धर्मवद्भिः स देवेशो नमस्कार्यः सदोद्यतैः॥ धर्म एव परो हि स्यात् तस्मिन्नभ्यर्चिते विभौ।
en: All persons knowing religion and duties should, with great readiness, bow down to that Lords of all the gods. By adoring that powerful one, one will acquire great merit.

sa: तमानय यथोद्दिष्टं पूजा कार्या हि तस्य वै। स गत्वा प्रतिकूलं तच्चकार यमशासनम्॥
en: Do you bring the individual I want. He should be adored with respect. The messenger, doing there, did the very reverse of what he had been ordered to do.

sa: धारणं सर्ववेदानां सर्वतीर्थावगाहनम्। सत्यं च ब्रुवतो नित्यं समं वा स्यान्न वा समम्॥
en: Keeping all the Vedas in memory, or ablutions performed in all the sacred waters, may or may not be equal to telling the Truth every day in one's life.

sa: यद् दुर्लभं हि लोकेऽस्मिन् रत्नमत्यातं महत्। तदानयेयं तपसा न हि मेऽत्रास्ति संशयः॥
en: Whatever gem, exceedingly wonderful and of great value, exists in this world, I shall bring for you with the help of my penances. I have no doubt in this.

sa: उमोवाच स्त्रीधर्मो मां प्रति यथा प्रतिभाति यथाविधि। तमहं कीर्तयिष्यामि तथैव प्रश्रिता भव॥
en: Uma said I shall, according to the ordinance, describe the subject of women's duties as far as they are known to me. Do you all listen with rapt attention.

sa: देवानां सुमहान् यच्च यच्चास्य विषयो महान्। यच्च विश्वं महत् पाति महादेवस्ततः स्मृतः॥
en: Because he is the foremost of all the celestials, and because his dominion and acquisitions are very extensive, and because he protects the vast universe, therefore is called Mahadeva.

sa: तस्मात् तांस्ते प्रवक्ष्यामि तडागे ये गुणाः स्मृताः। या च तत्र फलावाप्तिर्ऋषिभिः समुदाहृता॥
en: I shall, therefore, recite to you the merits attached to tanks as described by great Rishis, and the rewards in store for persons who cause them to be excavated.

sa: आदित्या इव दीप्यन्ते तेजसा भुवि मानवाः। ददन्ति वसुधां स्फीतां ये वेदविदुषि द्विजे॥
en: Those men who make gifts of ample and fertile earth to Brahmanas knowing the Vedas, always shine in the world, on account of their energy, like so many suns.

sa: तथैव देवता राजन् नात्र कार्या विचारणा। तथैव तेऽपि प्रीयन्ते येषां भवति तद्धविः॥
en: The deities also become pleased when the Brahmanas are pleased. There is no doubt in this. They who give away the sacrificial Havi to the Brahmanas become themselves pleased.

sa: एवं स्वेनाग्निना राजा समायुक्तो महीपते। मा शोचिथास्त्वं नृपतिं गतः स परमां गतिम्॥
en: Thus, O lord of Earth, king Dhritarashtra, coming into contact with his own sacred fire, departed from this world and attained to that high end that has been his.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततो युधिष्ठिरो राजा शरतल्पे पितामहम्। पुनरेव महातेजाः पप्रच्छ वदतां वरः॥
en: Vaishampayana said After this, king, Yudhishthira gifted with great energy, and the foremost of eloquent men, addressed his grandfather lying on his bed of arrows, in the following words.

sa: हत्वा छित्त्वा च शीर्षाणि रुदतां रुदतीं गृहात्। प्रसह्य हरणं तात राक्षसो विधिरुच्यते॥
en: Killing and chopping off the heads of weeping kinsmen, the bridegroom sometimes forcibly takes away the girl he marries. Such marriage, O son, passes by the name of Rakshasa.

sa: अनुबधे च कल्याणं यद् वचो ब्रह्मवादिनः। इयं हि वसुधा सर्वा क्षीणरत्ना कुरुद्वहाः॥
en: Those words spoken by those utters of Brahma are certain (if obeyed) to produce considerable benefit. You perpetuators of Kuru's race, the Earth has become divested of her riches.

sa: पिता रक्षति कौमारे भर्ता रक्षति यौवने। पुत्राश्च स्थाविरे भावे न स्त्री स्वातन्त्र्यमर्हति॥
en: In childhood, the father protects her. The husband protects her in youth. When she becomes old, her sons protect her. At no period of her life is woman free.

sa: मे अपश्यत् परिमार्गश्च तां गां परगृहे द्विजः। ममेयमिति चोवाच ब्राह्मणो यस्य साभवत्॥
en: The true owner, returning home, sought for his lost cow and at last found it in the house of another. Finding her, the owner said, “This cow is mine."

sa: मरुत्त उवाच शिवेन मां पश्य नमश्च तेऽस्तु प्राप्तो यज्ञः सफलं जीवितं मे। अयं यज्ञं कुरुते मे सुरेन्द्र बृहस्पतेरवरजो विप्रमुख्यः॥
en: Marutta said-Do you look with kindness upon me, I bow to you, O Indra, by your presence, my sacrifice has been perfected, and my life too blessed with good results. O Surendra, this excellent Brahmana, the younger brother of Brihaspati is engaged in celebrating my sacrifices.

sa: भुवि कृत्वा शुभं कर्म मोदन्ते दिवि दैवतैः॥ महेन्द्रगुरवः सप्त प्राची वै दिशमाश्रिताः।
en: Indeed, by doing good deeds on Earth, people sport happily in the celestial region, with the celestials. These Rishis are the priests of Indra. They live in the East.

sa: महेश्वर उवाच मेध्यान्वेषी महीं कृत्स्नां विचराम्यनिशं सदा। न च मेध्यतरं किंचिच्छ्मशानादिह लक्ष्यते॥
en: Maheshvara said I always travel over the whole Earth in search after a sacred spot. I do not, however, see any spot that is more sacred than the crematorium.

sa: श्रीभगवानुवाच तिलोत्तमा नाम पुरा ब्रह्मणा योषिदुत्तमा। तिलं तिलं समुद्धृत्य रन्तानां निर्मितां शुभा॥
en: The Blessed and Holy One said Formerly a blessed and foremost of women, was created by Brahman, called Tilottama, by collecting beauty from every beautiful object in the universe.

sa: आददीत बलं राजा मौलं मित्रबलं तथा। अटवीबलं भृतं चैव तथा श्रेणीबलं प्रभो॥
en: The king should provide himself with power of wealth, power of allies, power of foresters, power of paid soldiery, and the inechanical and trading classes, powerful power of one.

sa: नीत्वा तं यमदूतोऽपि गृहीत्वा शर्मिणं तदा। ययौ स धर्मराजाय न्यवेदयत चापि तम्॥
en: Having thus conveyed him back to his abode, the messenger of Yama fetched Sharmin who had really been sought by Yama. Taking Sharmin to him, he informed his inaster.

sa: गौतम उवाच न तल्लोके द्रव्यमस्ति यल्लोकं प्रतिपूरयेत्। समुद्रकल्पः पुरुषो न कदाचन पूर्यते॥
en: Gautama said All the objects which exist in the world cannot satisfy even a single person. Man is like the ocean, for he can never be filled (i.e., satisfied)

sa: बीजैरशून्यं शयनैरुपेतं दद्याद् गृहं यः पुरुषो द्विजाय। पुण्याभिरामं बहुरत्नपूर्ण लभत्यधिष्ठानवरं स राजन्॥
en: That man, O king, who presents to a Brahmana a house that is stored with grain, furnished with beds, full of riches, auspicious, and delightful, acquires a palatial residence.

sa: सर्वं तारयते वंशं यस्य खाते जलाशये। गावः पिवन्ति विप्राश्च साधवश्च नराः सदा॥
en: The entire family of a person is rescued from hell and sin in whose well or tank or lake kine and Brahmanas and pious people constantly satisfy their thirst.

sa: वायव्यस्तु सदा स्पर्शस्त्वचा प्रज्ञायते च सः। त्वक्स्थश्चैव सदा वायुः स्पर्शने स विधीयते॥
en: Touch always belongs to the wind (as its quality). That is perceived by the skin. The wind that always lives in the skin has been appointed in apprehending touch.

sa: जहाति मृत्युं च जरां भयं च न क्षुत्पिपासे मनसोऽप्रियाणि। दन्यत्र वै चेन्द्रियप्रीणनाद्धि॥
en: Death does away with decrepitude, fear, as also hunger and thirst and all that is disagreeable to the mind. There is no duty there but delighting in one's senses.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच नाज्ञापयद् वचनात् फाल्गुनस्य। आचक्षध्वं विजयं पार्थिवस्य भग्नाः परे विजिताश्चापि गावः॥
en: Vaishampayana said Thereupon, at the words of Phalguni, Uttara speedily dispatched messengers to announce the king's victory with the messages “The enemies have been defeated and the kine rescued."

sa: न वृद्धिर्बहु मन्तव्या या वृद्धिः क्षयमावहेत्। क्षयोऽपि बहु मन्तव्यो यः क्षयो वृद्धिमावहेत्॥
en: That gain should not be highly thought of, which brings on a little loss; and that loss should be considered a great one, which brings on a little gain.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततो देशे समे स्निग्धे प्रभूतयवसेन्धने। निवेशयामास तदा सेनां राजा युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: Vaishampayana said Then in a part of the field which was level, shady and where there was plenty of fodder's and fuel the king Yudhishthira had his army encamped.

sa: शास्त्रबुद्धया विनिश्चित्य कृत्वा बुद्धिं वधे दृढाम्॥ अथ वैश्वानरनिभं घोररूपं भयावहम्। मुमोच वज्रं संक्रुद्धः शक्रस्त्रिशिरसं प्रति॥ स पपात हतस्तेन वज्रेण दृढमाहतः। पर्वतस्येव शिखरं प्रणुन्नं मेदिनीतले॥
en: Deciding on this course of action laid down in the books, he firmly resolved on slaying him. Shakra, wrathful, flung his fearful and dress-inspiring thunderbolt, which could be compared to the fire, on the head of the three-headed one. Being severely struck by the thunderbolt he fell down to the earth, like the loosened summit of a mountain.

sa: कस्तमुत्सहते जेतुं त्रिषु लोकेषु भारत। वीरं कपिध्वजं जिष्णुं यस्य नास्ति समो युधि॥
en: O Bharata, who can are defeat in the three worlds, the heroic Vishnu, having the emblem of a monkey on his banner and none equal to him in battle?

sa: न च स्वपिषि जागर्षि न्युब्जः शेषे परंतप। घोरामशान्तां रुषती सदा वाचं प्रभाषसे॥
en: You do not sleep but are awake with your face bent downwards, O you chastiser of your enemies; and you always speak terrible and wrathful words inclined towards war.

sa: तथा विनियताः सर्वे ये च तेषां पदानुगाः। बभूवुः सैनिका राज्ञां प्रियं राज्ञश्चिकीर्षवः॥
en: These men being thus treated with respect, and those foot soldiers who constituted the army of the king Duryodhana became desirous of doing what was beneficial to that king.

sa: शुश्राव तस्य वैदेही ततस्तां करुणां गिरम्॥ सा प्राद्रवद् यतः शब्दस्तामुवाचाथ लक्ष्मणः। अलं ते शङ्कया भीरु को रामं प्रहरिष्यति॥ मुहूर्ताद् द्रक्ष्यसे रामं भर्तारं त्वं शुचिस्मिते।
en: And (when) the princess of Videha heard those piteous cries, she was about to run towards the direction from which the sound came. Then Lakshmana spoke to her, "O timid lady, there is no reason for your fear. Who is able to strike Rama? O lady of sweet smiles, you will in a moment see your lord Rama."

sa: प्राप्त: स्यां यद्यहं वीर वधं तस्मिन् महारणे॥ श्रेयस्तद् भविता मह्यं नैवंभूतस्य जीवितम्।
en: O hero, if I had met with my death in that great battle that would have been far better than that I have obtained my life in this way.

sa: अप्युदासीनवृत्तिः स्याद् यथा नः कुरुभिः सह। वासुदेव तथा कार्यं न कुरूननयः स्पृशेत्॥
en: O Son of Vasudeva, act in such a way that we may live as strangers to the Kurus; but let not the sin of annihilating men touch the Kurus.

sa: अयं कर्ता न क्रियते कारणं चापि पौरुषे। यद् यदिच्छेदयं शौरिस्तत् तत् कुर्यादयत्नतः॥
en: He is the doer of everything but himself is not created and he is the cause of all power. This Shouri can perform without any effort whatever he wishes

sa: अहं हि सततं गोषु भवता प्रहितः पुरा। तत्र मे कौशलं सर्वमवबुद्धं विशाम्पते।॥
en: Very often was I formerly employed by you in looking after your cows. O Lord of the earth, all the arts that the business involves are known to me.

sa: नूनं हि बालया धातुर्मया वै विप्रियं कृतम्। यस्य प्रसादाद् दुर्नीतं प्राप्तास्मि भरतर्षभ॥
en: O foremost of the Bharata race, certainly in my childhood I did some wrongful act to Dhata and through his displeasure I have fallen into such a woeful plight.

sa: दुर्योधन उवाच उभौ स्व एकजातीयौ तथोभौ भूमिगोचरौ। अथ कस्मात् पाण्डवानामेकतो मन्यसे जयम्॥
en: Duryodhana said Both the parties are of the same race and both roam about on the earth; why then do you regard victory as coming solely to the Pandavas.

sa: जुह्वत्यग्नौ हविः क्षीरं मन्त्रवत् सुसमाहिताः। ब्राह्मणा वेदवेदाङ्गपारगाः सुदृढव्रताः॥ कर्मसिद्धौ तदा तत्र जृम्भमाणा महाद्भुता। कृत्या समुत्थिता राजन् किं करोमीति चाब्रवीत्॥
en: Brahmanas of rigid vows well-versed in the Vedas and their branches began with great and deep meditation to pour libations of ghee and milk into the fire with mantras. After those rites were completed, a strange goddess, O king, rose up saying, "What shall I do?"

sa: धर्म उवाच उपपन्नो गुणैरेतैः स्वभावेनासि पाण्डव। भवान् धर्मः पुनश्चैव यथोक्तं ते भविष्यति॥
en: Dharma said: You are by nature gifted with all those virtues, O Pandava. You are (the very embodiment of) Virtue (itself) However, may you again have what you desire.

sa: सञ्जय उवाच दुर्योधनो वाचमिमां शृणोतु यदब्रवीदर्जुनो योत्स्यमानः। युधिष्ठिरस्यानुमते महात्मा धनंजयः शृण्वतः केशवस्य॥
en: Sanjaya said Let Duryodhana listen to this speech which was made by Arjuna, who was eager to fight, with the permission of Yudhishthira and in the hearing of Keshava.

sa: रश्मीन् समुत्सृज्य ततो महात्मा रथादवप्लुत्य विराटपुत्रः। वस्त्राण्युपादाय महारथानां तूर्णं पुन: स्वं रथमारुरोह॥
en: The son of Virata immediately left the rein of his horses and jumped down from chariot. He collected the clothes of those warriors and again rod on his chariot.

sa: तत्र यो बलवान् कृष्ण जित्वा सोऽत्ति तदामिषम्। एवमेव मनुष्येषु विशेषो नास्ति कश्चन॥
en: In the fight the one, who is stronger, O Krishna, gains the victory and eats the other's flesh. Such is the case with men; there is no difference whatever.

sa: विदुरस्यापि तद् वाक्यं श्रुतं भीष्मस्य चोभयोः। कुन्त्याश्च विपुलप्रज्ञ प्रज्ञा कात्स्न्येन ते श्रुता॥
en: The words of Vidura have been heard by you as also those of Bhishma, as also the entire wisdom of the greatly wise Kunti, as embodied in her words.

sa: तस्मात् त्वमपि गान्धारे मानं क्रोधं च वर्जय। संधत्स्व पाण्डवैवीर संरम्भं त्यज पार्थिव॥
en: Therefore, do you also, O son of Gandhari, abandon vanity and with; ( hero make peace with the sons of Pandu and abandon wrath, O ruler of the earth.

sa: अमृतं चाहृतं विष्णो दैत्याच निहता रणे। बलिं बद्ध्वा महादैत्यं शक्रो देवाधिपः कृतः॥
en: And O Vishnu, robbed it of nectar and killed in battle all the Daityas and after slaying Vali the great Daityas appointed Shakra, as the lord of the gods.

sa: अनपत्यस्य पुत्रोऽयं देवैर्दत्तो ध्रुवं मम। इत्युक्त्वा तं ददौ पुत्रं राधायै स महीपते॥
en: Surely, considering that I have no son, the gods have sent this child to me.” O lord of the earth, saying this, he made over the child to Radha.

sa: विराटवाक्येन च तेन चोदिता नरा विराटस्य सुशीघ्रगामिनः। उपेत्य कौन्तेयमथाब्रुवंस्तदा यथा स राजावदताच्युतानुजम्॥
en: Thus commissioned by the words of Virata, his quick-paced messengers went to the son of Kunti and told that younger brother of Yudhishthira all that the king had said.

sa: अग्नौ प्रास्तं तु पुरुषं कर्मान्वेति स्वयंकृतम्। तस्मात् तु पुरुषो यत्नाद् धर्मं संचिनुयाच्छनैः॥
en: Deeds done by his own self follow a man thrown into the funeral pyre; therefore should a man carefully and in slow degrees pick up the fruits of virtue.

sa: न मे प्रयोजनं किंचिद् गमने पन्नगाशन। संनिवर्त महाभाग न वेगं विषहामि ते॥
en: I have no need whatever of this journey, O you who subsist on snakes; return, O you of great attributes, for I can not bear this speed of yours.

sa: स्पृष्ट्वा मूर्धनि तान् पुत्रांस्तापसी वाक्यमब्रवीत्। दौहित्रास्तव राजेन्द्र मम पुत्रा न ते पराः॥
en: And having touched those sons of hers on their head the anchoring said these words "These are your grandsons, O chief among kings-my sons-they are not unconnected with you.

sa: एष भद्रे मया मुक्तो भर्ता ते कुलनन्दिनि। अरोगस्तव नेयश्च सिदार्थः स भविष्यति॥
en: "O chaste and gentle lady, I release your husband. You will be able to take him back. He will be free from disease and (ever) successful (in his undertakings).

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच गावल्गणेऽत्र का भक्तिर्या ते नित्या जनार्दने। यया त्वमभिजानासि त्रियुगं मधुसूदनम्॥
en: Dhritarashtra said O son of Gavalgani, what is the extent of the belief you ever have in Janardana, by which you Janardana, who is the union of the three.

sa: नारद उवाच अयं लोकः सुपर्णानां पक्षिणां पन्नगाशिनाम्। विक्रमे गमने भारे नैषामस्ति परिश्रमः॥
en: Narada said This region belongs to the birds of excellent feathers which subsist on snakes. They feel no fatigue in showing their strength in traveling or in carrying loads.

sa: क्षपयिष्यति नः सर्वान् स सुव्यक्तं महारणे। विदितं मे हृषीकेश यतो धर्मस्ततो जयः॥
en: This plainly indicates that in the great battle he will kill all of us. It is known to me, O Hrishikesha, that where there is virtue there is victory.

sa: सैरन्ध्युवाच तस्मिञ्जीवति पापिष्ठे सेनावाहे मम द्विषि॥ तत् कर्म कृतवानद्य कथं निद्रां निषेवसे।
en: Sairandhri said How can you enjoy the sweets of sleep while that foe of mine, the wretched commander of Virata's forces, lives still, having perpetrated that foul deed today?

sa: पुत्र उवाच नेयं मतिस्त्वया वाच्या मातः पुत्रे विशेषतः। कारुण्यमेवात्र पश्य भूत्वेह जडमूकवत्॥
en: The son said You should not speak in this strain, O mother, especially to your son; exercise your compassion only in this case like a silent and dumb woman.

sa: यद्यत्र न रुचिः काचिदेहि गच्छाव मातले। तं नयिष्यामि देशं त्वां वरं यत्रोपलप्स्यसे।॥
en: If nobody, in these regions, is to your liking, O Matali, then come, we shall go elsewhere and lead you to that country where you will get a bridegroom.

sa: भीष्मद्रोणौ कृपद्रौणी विदुरः संजयस्तथा। बाह्रीकः सौमदत्तिश्च ये चान्ये वृद्धसम्मताः॥ ब्राह्मणाः श्रेणिमुख्याश्च तथोदासीनवृत्तयः। किं मां वक्ष्यन्ति किं चापि प्रतिवक्ष्यामि तानहम्॥
en: What will Bhishma, Drona, Kripa, the son of Drona (Ashvathama), Vidura, Sanjaya, the son of Balhika (king), the son of Somadatta and the other revered chiefs and also the chief men of independent professions say to me and what shall I say to them in return?

sa: यदि वृत्रं न हम्यद्य वञ्चयित्वा महासुरम्। महाबलं महाकायं न मे श्रेयो भविष्यति॥
en: If I do not this day slay the great Asura, Vritra of great strength and of a huge body by an artifice, it will not be well with me.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच दुर्योधन विजानीहि यत् त्वां वक्ष्यामि पुत्रका उत्पथं मन्यसे मार्गमनभिज्ञ इवाध्वगः॥
en: Dhritarashtra said O Duryodhana, think well on what I am telling you, my dear son. You think the wrong way to be the right one like an inexperienced wayfarer.

sa: रथं तु दिव्यं कौन्तेयः सर्वा विभ्राजयन् दिशः। मन्त्रं जिज्ञासमानः सन् बीभत्सुः समयोजयत्॥
en: The son of Kunti, roamed about in his heavenly car in all directions. Vibhatsu, yoked the horses to it to test the efficacy of the Mantras (obtained by him).

sa: मार्कण्डेय उवाच साभिवाद्याब्रवीच्छ्वधू श्वशुरं च महाव्रता। अयं गच्छति मे भर्ता फलाहारो महावनम्॥
en: Markandeya said : (Then) bowing down to her mother-in-law and father-in-law, she of great vows said (to them) "my husband is going to the great forest for gathering fruits.

sa: यत्र मां भगवान् राजा श्वशुरो वाक्यमब्रवीत्। वरं वृणीष्व पाञ्चालि वराहा॑ऽसि मता मम॥
en: On this the prosperous king (Dhritarashtra), my father-in-law, said these words chose a boon, O Princess of Panchala, in my opinion you are the proper recipient of a boon.”

sa: अथ वर्माणि चित्राणि काञ्चनानि बहूनि च। विविधानि च शस्त्राणि चक्रुः सर्वाणि सर्वशः॥
en: All those warriors then began to take up diverse sorts of coats of mail, many amours which were made of gold and all sorts of weapon in all directions.

sa: कश्चान्यो भ्रातृभार्यां वै विप्रकर्तुं तथाऽर्हति। आनीय च सभां व्यक्तं यथोक्ता द्रौपदी त्वया।॥
en: Who else save yourself could treat the wife of your brother in that way and after brining Draupadi to that council hall and using insulting words as you did?

sa: कथं हि पीत्वा माध्वीकं पीत्वा च मधुमाधवीम्। लोभं सौवीरके कुर्यान्नारी काचिदिति स्मरेत्॥
en: How can a lady who has tasted of the sweet wire prepare . out of honey or flowers, be tempted to drink the (wretched) wine prepared from peutrid rice”!

sa: ततः सपुत्रः सिद्धार्थो भुड्क्ष्व भोगान् परंतप। अजातशत्रु जानीषे स्थितं धर्मं सतां सदा॥
en: Enjoy the blessings of life, O chastiser of foes, along with your sons under the attainment of your objects. You know that Yudhishthira follows the course of virtue always.

sa: नैव प्रशममत्र त्वं मन्यसे सुकरं प्रभो। लोभाद् वा धृतराष्ट्रस्य दैन्याद् वा समुपस्थितात्॥
en: That you do not consider peace to be easily obtainable in this instance, O Lord, owing either to avarice on the part of Dhritarashtra or the weakness of ourselves.

sa: वाक्संयमो हि नृपते सुदुष्करतमो मतः। अर्थवच्च विचित्रं च न शक्यं बहु भाषितुम्॥
en: The control over speech, O lord of men, is thought to be most difficult; and it is not possible to speak much full of meaning in an entertaining way.

sa: तदा प्रभृति राजा च शकुनिश्चापि सौबलः। जानते निर्जितान् पार्थान् कर्णेन युधि भारत॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, from that day king Duryodhana and Shakuni, the son of Subala, thought that the sons of Pritha (the Pandavas) had already been defeated by Karna.

sa: पापोदयफलं विद्वान् यो नारभति वर्धते। यस्तु पूर्वकृतं पापमविमृश्यानुवर्तते। अगाधपङ्गे दुर्मेधा विषमे विनिपात्यते॥
en: That wise man, who dose not do acts which result in sin, grows (in prosperity); but the man of slow intelligence who continues in his sinful course commenced before,

sa: अत्र पीत्वा समस्तान् वै वरुणस्य रसांस्तु षट्। जायते तरुणः सोमः शुक्लस्यादौ तमिस्रहा।॥
en: Here having drunk all the six juices of Varuna, the moon, the destroyer of darkness, becomes new again in the very beginning of the light half of the month.

sa: अद्यैव जहि मां राजन् मरणे नास्ति मे व्यथा। यः शरेणैकपुत्रं मां त्वमकार्षीरपुत्रकम्॥
en: Do you, O monarch, slay me on the instant. I do not grieve to die', you have by your shaft rendered me who had an only son, absolutely sonless.

sa: धर्मबन्धेन बद्धोऽस्मि नष्टा च मम चेतना। ज्येष्ठं पुत्रं प्रियं रामं द्रष्टुमिच्छामि धार्मिकम्॥
en: I have been bound fast by the ties of virtue, therefore have I lost my senses. I now only wish to behold my beloved eldest son, the righteous Rama.

sa: न्यवेदयत् चात्मानं तस्मै लक्ष्मणपूर्वजः। पुत्रौ दशरथस्यावां भगवन् रामलक्ष्मणौ॥ भार्या ममेयं कल्याणी वैदेही जनकात्मजा। मां चानुयाता विजनं तपोवनमनिन्दिता॥ पित्रा प्रव्राज्यमानं मां सौमित्रिरनुजः प्रियः। अयमन्वगमद् भ्राता वनमेव धृतव्रतः॥
en: Then Lakşmaņa's elder brother imparted to Bharadvāja a knowledge of himself. “O worshipful one, we are the sons of Dasaratha, Rama and Laksmana. This is my wife, the auspicious daughter of Janaka. This blameless one follows me to the solitary forest; and my dear younger brother, the son of Sumitrā too, observing the vow, follows me, who have been exiled by my father,

sa: यदा तु ते वरं दद्यात् स्वयमुत्थाप्य राघवः। व्यवस्थाप्य महाराजं त्वमिमं वृणुया वरम्॥
en: And when that descendant of Raghu, raising you will go to bestow the boons, do you then binding him fast by oath, unfold to the monarch the boons, saying.

sa: नात्र जीवेन्मृषावादी क्रुरो वा यदि वा शठः। नृशंसः पापवृत्तो वा मुनिरेष तथाविधः॥
en: And the ascetic is such that a liar cannot live here, nor a cunning or a crafty person, nor a wicked wight, nor one that is given to unrighteousness.

sa: शुष्ककाष्ठैर्भवेत् कार्यं लोष्ठैरपि च पांसुभिः। न तु स्थानात् परिभ्रष्टैः कार्यं स्याद् वसुधाधिपैः।।१८।
en: Even dry wood may serve a purpose; or stone, or dust; but no purpose is capable of being served by a sovereign that has been cast off his place.

sa: पुरा प्रेक्ष्य सुवृत्तं मां पिता यान्याह सान्त्वयन्। वाक्यानि तानि श्रोष्यामि कुतः कर्णसुखान्यहम्॥
en: And from whom shall I hear those words grateful to the ear, which my father gratifying me used to speak to me when I happened to do something well?

sa: स तत्र शुश्राव च हर्षयुक्ता रामाभिषेकार्थकृतां जनानाम्। नरेन्द्रसूनोरभिमङ्गलार्थाः सर्वस्य लोकस्य गिरः प्रहृष्टाः॥
en: And he became exceedingly pleased on hearing pleasant words, meaning well to the son of the king, from all persons, engaged in some sort of service for the installation.

sa: नातन्त्री वाद्यते वीणा नाचक्रो विद्यते रथः। नापतिः सुखमेधेत या स्यादपि शतात्मजा ॥
en: The Viņā without strings does not sound; and the car without wheels does not move, so although having an hundred sons, a woman without her husband cannot attain happiness.

sa: देवतानां पितृणां च मातापित्रोस्तथैव च। मा स्म कार्षीत् स शुश्रूषां यस्यार्योऽनुमते गतः।॥
en: May he that had approved the exile of that noble one into the woods, never serve the gods or the manes of the ancestors or his father and mother!

sa: स हि प्रसादे चात्यर्थकोपे च हरिरीश्वरः। अतीत्य तस्य संदेशं विनाशो गमने भवेत्॥
en: He is extreme both in showing favour and in anger. Disregarding his order, we shall, going there, meet with destruction. And his ire shall, not take any other course.

sa: क्वचित् परिदशान् मासानेकसंवत्सरं क्वचित्॥ क्वचित चतुरो मासान् पञ्च षट् च परान् क्वचित। अपरत्राधिकान् मासानध्यर्धमधिकं क्वचित्॥ त्रीन्मासानष्टमासांश्च राघवो न्यवसत् सुखम्।
en: And Rāghava happily passed his days somewhere for ten months, somewhere for one year, somewhere for four months somewhere for five or six months, somewhere for many months, somewhere for a month and a half, somewhere for more, somewhere for three months, and somewhere for eight.

sa: आनम्य मूर्ध्नि चाघ्राय परिष्वज्य यशस्विनी। अवदत् पुत्रमिष्टार्थो गच्छ राम यथासुखम्॥ अरोगं सर्वसिद्धार्थमयोध्यां पुनरागतम्। पश्यामि त्वां सुखं वत्स संधितं राजवर्त्मसु॥
en: Oh my son, Oh Rāma, have your desires attained, and do you go, wherever you like. I shall see you. Oh my darling, with great delight, when shall you, returning Ayodhyā in excellent health and having all your ends satisfied, resume the administration of your kingdom.

sa: एवमुक्तो नरपतिर्ब्राह्मणैर्वेदपारगैः। गवां शतसहस्राणि दश तेभ्यो ददौ नृपः॥ दशकोटिं सुवर्णस्य रजतस्य चतुर्गुणम्।
en: Thus addressed by the Brāhmaṇas versed in the Veda, that best of kings bestowed upon them ten lace of kine, and ten Koțis of gold, and forty of silver.

sa: अज्ञानाद् भवतः पुत्रः सहसाभिहतो मया। शेषमेवं गते यत्स्यात् तत् प्रसीदतु मे मुनिः॥
en: It is through ignorance that I suddenly wounded your son. This having been past, do you favour me with telling me what is now to be done, O ascetic.

sa: यदि पुत्र न जायेथा मम शोकाय राघव। न स्म दुःखमतो भूयः पश्येयमहमप्रजाः॥
en: Oh! my son, Oh! Rāghava, had you not been born for my grief I would have been sonless only, but would not have been subject to this greater grief.

sa: ऊनद्वादशवर्णोऽयमकृतास्त्रश्च राघवः॥ कामं तु मम तत् सैन्यं मया सह गमिष्यति। बलेन चतुरङ्गेण स्वयमेत्य निशाचरम्॥ वधिष्यामि मुनिश्रेष्ठ शत्रु तव यथेप्सितम्।
en: Rāghava is still under twelve years of age and had not been well disciplined in military arts. But I have soldiers enough, and if permitted by you, O you best of ascetics, I shall with my fourfold forces kill your enemies, the rangers of the night.

sa: तथा तस्मिन् विलपति वसिष्ठो राजधर्मवित्। सभामिक्ष्वाकुनाथस्य प्रविवेश महायशाः॥ शातकुम्भमयीं रम्यां मणिहेमसमाकुलाम्। सुधर्मामिव धर्मात्मा सगणः प्रत्यपद्यत ॥ स काञ्चनमयं पीठं स्वस्त्यास्तरणसंवृतम्। अध्यास्त सर्ववेदज्ञो दूताननुशशास च॥
en: As Bharata was mourning thus, the highly famous and virtuous Vasistha accompanied by his disciples entered the court of the Ikşvāku king: built of entire gold, charming, dazzling with gems and gold: like to Sudharmä its. Sitting down on a golden seat furnished with a elegant cover, that one versed in all the Vedas commanded the envoys, saying.

sa: स तु सुप्ते जने रात्रौ किष्किन्धाद्वारमागतः। नर्दति स्म सुसंरब्धो वालिनं चाह्वयद् रणे॥
en: It came to pass that one night when all had fallen asleep, (Māyāvi) coming to Kişkindhā, began to emit roars in great wrath, and challenged Väli to an encounter.

sa: स्तापेन दुःखेन च पीड्यमानः। आलिङ्गय पुत्रं सुविनष्टसंज्ञो भूमिं गतो नैव विचष्ट किंचित्॥
en: Thus benetted with calamities and exercised with grief and anguish, the king embraced his son, and then deprived of his consciousness, fell down on the ground and became motionless.

sa: तामपश्यत् पुनस्तत्र तपः परममास्थितः। स तेन तोषितश्चासीदत्यन्तं रघुनन्दन॥ विससर्ज ततो गङ्गां हरो बिन्दुसरः प्रति। तस्यां विसृज्यमानायां सप्त स्रोतांसि जज्ञिरे॥
en: And finding Gangā in this plight, Bhagīratha became again engaged in high austerities. And thereupon Siva, O descendant of Raghu, was exceedingly gratified; and cast Gangā off in the direction of the Bindu lake. And as she was let off, seven streams branched out from her.

sa: स्वागतं वा नरव्याघ्रौ दिष्ट्या पश्यामि वामहम्। दिष्ट्या चेमौ निकृत्तौ मे युवाभ्यां बाहुबन्धनौ॥
en: O two best of men, you are welcome! By my good luck it is that I do behold you. By my good fortune you have dissevered my shoulders today.

sa: नाहं तामनुशोचामि प्राकृतो वानरोऽपि सन्। महात्मा च विनीतश्च किं पुन तिमान् महान्॥
en: A despicable monkey as I am, I do not grieve for her,-and what again shall I say of one that is magnanimous, endued with meekness and firmness, and great?

sa: यदा वक्तुं स्वयं दैन्यान्न शशाक महीपतिः। तदा सुमन्त्रं मन्त्रज्ञा कैकेयी प्रत्युवाच ह॥
en: Seeing the king utterly incapable of speaking any thing personally owing to his heavy sorrow, Kaikeyī, the best counsellor in matters like these, addressed Sumantra with the following words.

sa: एषोऽस्त्रान् विविधान् वेत्ति त्रैलोक्ये सचराचरे। नैनमन्यः पुमान् वेत्ति न च वेत्स्यन्ति केचन॥
en: This one is congnizant of all that exist in the three worlds furnished with mobile and immobile things;. but others do not know him,-nor yet shall know him hereafter.

sa: सूर्यस्यापि भवेत् सूर्यो ह्यग्नेरग्निः प्रभोः प्रभुः। श्रियाः श्रीश्च भवेदग्र्या कीर्त्याः कीर्तिः क्षमाक्षमा।।१५। दैवतं देवतानां च भूतानां भूतसत्तमः। तस्य के ह्यगुणा देवि वने वाप्यथवा पुरे॥
en: He is the sun of the sun, the lord of the lord, he is the auspiciousness of priine auspiciousness, the fame of fame, the forbearance of forbearance, the god of the gods, and the foremost of creatures. What evil qualities, O noble lady, will be perceived in him, whether he remains in the city or in the forest?

sa: कच्चित्ते सफला वेदाः कच्चित्ते सफलाः क्रियाः। कच्चित्ते सफला दाराः कच्चित्ते सफलं श्रुतम्॥
en: And do you observe the Vedas? And do you perceive the fruit of your acts? And have your wives borne children? And has your knowledge of scripture borne fruit?

sa: गमने सुकृतां बुद्धिं न ते शक्नोमि पुत्रक॥ विनिवर्तयुतुं वीर नूनं कालो दुरत्ययः।
en: Oh my darling! it is beyond my power to dissuade you from your firm resolution for going to the forest; it is impossible to avoid this hour of separation.

sa: तौ प्रयान्तौ महावीरों दिव्यां त्रिपथगां नदीम्। ददृशाते ततस्तत्र सरय्वाः संगमे शुभे ॥
en: And as those ones endowed with exceeding prowess were proceeding, at the shining confluence of the Sarayū and the Gangā they bcheld a noble river flowing in three branches.

sa: यज्ञो मे क्रियतां ब्रह्मन् यथोक्तं मुनिपुङ्गव। यथा न विघ्नाः क्रियन्ते यज्ञाङ्गेषु विधीयताम्॥
en: O Brahman, undertake to perform this sacrifice of mine, according to the ordinance, O foremost of ascetics! do you order so that no impediment may happen to the sacrifice!.

sa: स तेऽहं पितुराचार्यस्तव चैव परंतप। मम त्वं वचनं कुर्वन् नातिवर्तेः सतां गतिम्॥
en: I, O subduer of foes, have been the preceptor of both yourself and your father. By doing what I say, you will not lose the state of the righteous.

sa: को ह्यविद्वानपि पुमान् प्रमदायाः कृते त्यजेत्। छन्दानुवर्तिनं पुत्रं तातो मामिव लक्ष्मण ॥
en: O Lakşmana, what man is there ignorant though he be, who for the sake of a female forsake as my father has done me, his son following his foot-steps?

sa: न च पुत्रगतं स्नेहं कर्तुमर्हसि पार्थिव॥ अहं ते प्रतिजानामि हतौ तौ विद्धि राक्षसौ। अहं वेनि महात्मानं रामं सत्यपराक्रमम्॥ वसिष्ठोऽपि महातेजा ये चेमे तपसि स्थिताः। यदि ते धर्मलाभं तु यशश्च परमं भुवि॥ स्थिरमिच्छसि राजेन्द्र रामं मे दातुमर्हसि।
en: Nor, o king, ought you to indulge in paternal affection. For ten nights only Rāma is to remain there, with the object of slaying those foes to my sacrifice, those Raksasas disturbing the rites. I tell you, do you consider the Raksasas as already slain. I know full well Rāma of sterling prowess, as also the highly-energetic Vasistha and the other ascetics present here. And if you, O king, set your heart upon acquiring religious merit and high fame on earth, do you then grant me Rāma!

sa: त्वं क्रीडसे षण्मुख कुक्कुटेन यथेष्टनानाविधकामरूपी। दीक्षासि सोमो मरुतः सदैव धर्मोऽसि वायुरचलेन्द्र इन्द्रः॥
en: O six-faced god, you play with the cock, you assume various forms according to your own will, you are Daksha, Soma, Marutas, Dharma, Vayu and the king of mountains.

sa: यथा दीपो निवातस्था निरिङ्गो ज्वलते पुनः। तथासि भगवन् देव पाषाण इव निश्चलः॥
en: O illustrious god, you are as calm as the flame of a lamp burning in a place where there is no wind. You are as immobile as a rock.

sa: प्रिये नातिभृशं हृष्येदप्रिये न च संज्वरेत्। न मुह्येदर्थकृच्छ्रेषु न च धर्मं परित्यजेत्॥
en: One should not express unnatural joy at good fortune or succumb under calamities. He should not grow dispirited, when overpowered by poverty or forsake his virtue when so overpowered.

sa: माद्रीपुत्रः सहदेवः कलिङ्गान् समागतानजयद् दन्तकरे। वामेनास्यन् दक्षिणेनैव यो वै महाबलं कच्चिदेनं स्मरन्ति॥
en: Sahadeva, the son of the king of Madri, conquered the combined Kalingas and Dantakura by (shooting arrows with) his right and left hands; do they remember this strong one?

sa: राजैव कर्ता भूतानां राजैव च विनाशकः। धर्मात्मा यः स कर्ता स्यादधर्मात्मा विनाशकः॥
en: The king is the creator of all creatures, and is their destroyer. That righteous king is regarded as the creator, while the sinful one is regarded as the destroyer.

sa: कृप उवाच सदैव तव राधेय युद्धे क्रूरतरा मतिः। नार्थानां प्रकृति वेत्सि नानुबन्धमवेक्षसे॥
en: Kripa said O son of Radha, your crooked mind is always for the war. You do not understand the time and nature of things as well as their consequences.

sa: चरणं मारुतोत्मेति प्राणापानौ च तन्मयौ। स्पर्शनं चेन्द्रियं विद्यात् तथा स्पर्श च तन्मयम्॥
en: Wind is essence of the feet. The vital airs are made of wind. Wind is the essence of the sense of touch, and touch is the attribute of wind.

sa: द्रौणिश्चुकोप पार्थाय कृष्णाय च विशेषतः। स तु यत्तो रथे स्थित्वा वार्युपस्पृश्य वीर्यवान्॥
en: Namely the son of Drona, became extremely angry with Dhananjaya and specially with Krishna. Then that highly puissant hero, staying carefully on his car ruiced his mouth with water.

sa: स तु ज्ञात्वा द्विजं प्राप्तं सहसा सम्भ्रमोत्थितः। आजगाम यतो विप्रः स्थित एकान्तदर्शने॥
en: Understanding that the twice-born one had come to him, he (fowler) suddenly got up from his seat and went to the place, where the Brahmana was standing in seclusion.

sa: ततः कुरूणामनयो भविता वीरनाशनः। चिन्तयन् न लभे निद्रामहः सु च निशासु च॥
en: Thereupon the misdeed of the Kurus will be the cause of a massacre of heroes; thinking of such things, I do not get sleep during day nor during night.”

sa: अथ कूले स्वके राजन् जपन्तमृषिसत्तमम्। जुह्वानं कौशिकं प्रेक्ष्य सरस्वत्यभ्यचिन्तयत्॥ इदमन्तरमित्येवं ततः सा सरितां वरा। कूलापहारमकरोत् स्वेन वेगेन सा सरित्॥
en: Seeing then that best of Rishis, viz., Vashishtha engaged in silent recitation of Mantras on her bank and seeing Kushika's son Vishvamitra also engaged in homa, Sarasvati thought, this is my opportunity.' Then that foremost of rivers, by her current, washed away one of her banks.

sa: यः कृशार्थः कृशगवः कृशभृत्यः कृशातिथिः। सवै राजन् कृशो नाम न शरीरकृशः कृशः॥
en: He whose limbs are lean is not truly a lean man, but he who is lean in respect of horses and kine and servants and guests is truly so.

sa: यस्मिन्देशे च काले च मापनेयं प्रवर्तिता। ब्राह्मणं कारणं कृत्वा नायं संस्थास्यते क्रतुः॥
en: “The land in which the platform was made and the time when it was measured indicate that this sacrifice will not be completed. A Brahmana will be its cause."

sa: स हि भूतं भविष्यच्च भवच्च भरतर्षभ। वेत्ति धर्मविदां श्रेष्ठं तमस्मि मनसा गतः॥
en: I was thinking of that best of all persons conversant with morality and duty, of him, O foremost of Bharatas, who knows the Past, the Future, and the Present.

sa: धिग् बलं भीमसेनस्य धिक् पार्थस्य च गाण्डिवम्। यौ मां विप्रकृतां क्षुद्रमर्षयेतां जनार्दन॥
en: O Janardana, fie to the prowess of Bhimasena and fie to the Gandiva of Arjuna, for they both suffered me to be thus disgraced by men of no importance!

sa: तमभिदुत्त्य संक्रुद्धो वेगेन महता बली। अगृहणात् पाणिना पाणिं भीमसेनस्य राक्षसः॥ इन्द्राशनिसमस्पर्श वज्र संहननं दृढम्। संहत्य भीमसेनाय व्याक्षिपत् सहसा करम्॥
en: Coming furiously and angrily at him, the mighty Rakshasas caught hold of Bhimasena's hand by his own. Catching hold of his other hand and making it as hard as the thunder of Indra, he suddenly struck Bhima a blow that descended with the force of lightning.

sa: यस्य बाहुबलाद् वीर सभा चासीत् पुरा मम। सर्वरत्नमयी ख्याता त्रिषु लोकेषु पाण्डव॥
en: O hero, O son of Pandu, it was through his prowess I formerly possessed the Assembly Hall adorned with all sorts of jewels and celebrated over the three worlds.

sa: अप्सु वै शयनं चक्रे महात्मा पुरुषोत्तमः। सर्वतेजोमयो देवो योगात् सुष्वाप तत्र ह॥
en: That Highest Soul, that Foremost of all Beings, laid himself down on the waters. Therein, that Divine One composed of all energies, was lulled in sleep through his Yoga.

sa: तस्य नान्याभवद् बुद्धिर्दिवसे दिवसे नृप। सत्रे क्रियासमारम्भे दानेषु विविधेषु च॥ ऋत्विग्भिः सहितो धीमानेवमीजे स भूमिपः। ततस्तु ऋत्विजश्चास्य धूमव्याकुललोचनाः॥ कालेन महता खिन्नास्तत्यजुस्ते नराधिपम्। ततः प्रचोदयामास ऋत्विजस्तान् महीपतिः॥ चक्षुर्विकलतां प्राप्ता न प्रपेदुश्च ते क्रतुम्।
en: O king, the heart of that monarch was always set upon sacrifices, religious rites and gifts of all kind. That greatly intelligent king performed sacrifices for many years, assisted by the Ritvijas till they, becoming weak and their eyes afflicted with smoke, left that king, wishing never more to assist him at his sacrifices. The king, however, again and again asked them to come to him, but on account of their sore eyes, they did not come.

sa: यस्तेनाशंसते योद्धं कर्तव्यं तस्य भेषजम्॥ आशीविषस्य क्रुद्धस्य पाणिमुद्यम्य दक्षिणम्। अवमुच्य प्रदेशिन्या दंष्ट्रामादातुमिच्छसि॥ अथवा कुद्द्वारं मत्तमेकं एव चरन् वने। अनङ्कुशं समारुह्य नगरं गन्तुमिच्छसि॥ समिद्धं पावकं चैव घृतमेदोवसाहुतम्। घृताक्तश्चारवासास्त्वं मध्येनोत्तर्तुमिच्छसि॥ आत्मानं कः समुद्बद्ध्य कण्ठे बद्ध्वा महाशिलम्।
en: He who wishes to fight with Arjuna should take some medicine. You desire to take out the fangs of an angry, venomous snake by stretching out your right hand and extending your fore-finger. Or going alone in the forest you wish to ride an infuriated elephant and go to a town without a hook in hand. Or rubbed over with clarified butter and clad in silken raiment you wish to go through a burning fire blazing with fat, tallow and clarified butter.

sa: महानात्मा तथाव्यक्तमहंकारस्तथैव च। इन्द्रियाणि दशैकं च महाभूतानि पञ्च च॥ विशेषाः पञ्चभूतानामिति सर्गः सनातनः। चतुर्विंशतिरेका च तत्त्वसंख्या प्रकीर्तिता॥
en: The great soul, the uninanifest, egoisin, the eleven organs (of knowledge and action), the five great elements, the characteristics of the five elements, these form the eternal creation. The number of clements has been said to be twenty-four and one (more).

sa: स दर्शयित्वा सैन्यानां स्वबाहुबलमात्मनः। तमुद्यम्य महाखङ्गं चर्म चाथ पुनर्बली॥ वृद्धक्षत्रस्य दायादं पितुरत्यन्तवैरिणम्। ससाराभिमुखः शूरः शार्दूल इव कुञ्जरम्॥
en: Then displaying to the troops the might of his own arms, that puissant hero again uplifting his heavy sword and his shield, advanced towards the son of Vriddhakshatra, the eternal enemy of his father, like a tiger rushing at an elephant.

sa: सूर्योदये युक्तसेनः प्रतीक्ष्य द्वजी रथी रक्ष तं सत्यसंधम्। अहं हि वः पश्यतां द्वीपमेनं भीष्मं रथात् पातयिष्यामि बाणैः॥
en: At sun rise, at the head of your army attend with your chariot and your flags on, that one devoted to truth and protect him. I shall within your sight by my arrows fell down from the chariot Bhishma, your refuge,

sa: त्यक्त्वा मन्युं व्युपशाम्यस्व पार्थैः पर्याप्तमेतद् यत् कृतं फाल्गुनेन। भीष्मस्यान्तादस्तु वः सौहृदं च जीवन्तु शेषाः साधु राजन् प्रसीद॥
en: Renouncing your wrath, do you conclude peace with the sons of Pritha. Enough has already been accomplished by Phalguna. Let amity be established among you with the death of Bhishma. Let the rest (of the warriors) live! Relent, reient, O monarch!

sa: नेतादृशानि युद्धानि भविष्यन्ति कथश्चन। न हि शक्यो रणे जेतुं भीष्मः पार्थेन धीमता॥ सधनुः सरथः साश्वः प्रवपन् सायकान् रणे। तथैव पाण्डवं युद्धे देवैरपि दुरासदम्॥ न विजेतुं रणे भीष्म उत्सहेत धनुर्धरम्। आलोकादपि युद्धं हि सममेतद् भविष्यति॥
en: Such a battle as this will never take place again. Bhishma is incapable of being vanquished in battle by the greatly wise Partha though he showers his arrows on the bow, car and steed of the forms. So also is that great bowman, the Pandava (Arjuna), incapable of being vanquished in battle by even the celestials. Bhishma is not competent to defeat him. As long as the world would last, so long would this battle be fought equally on both the sides.

sa: ननाद बलवन्नादं भगदत्तः प्रतापवान्। ततो घटोत्कचो राजन् प्रेक्ष्य भीमं तथागतम्॥ संक्रुद्धो राक्षसो घोरस्तत्रैवान्तरधीयत। स कृत्वा दारुणां मायां भीरूणां भयवर्धिनीम्॥ अदृश्यत निमेषार्धाद् घोररूपं समास्थितः। ऐरावणं समारूढः स वै मायाकृतं स्वयम्॥
en: The powerful Bhagadatta endued with great prowess uttered a loud roar. Then O monarch, the Rakshasa Ghatotkacha of dreadful appearance seeing Bhima ir that plight became inflamed with fury, and even there disappeared from the sight. And spreading a terrible illusion capable of enhancing the apprehension of the cowards, hc reappeared with a moment assuming a dreadful form, and riding on an Airavata the creation of his own illusive powers.

sa: पश्यायैतन्महाघोरे संयुगे वैशसं महत्। हेमचित्राणि शूराणां महान्ति च शुभानि च।॥ कवचान्यवदीर्यन्ते शरैः संनतपर्वभिः। छिद्यन्ते च ध्वजाग्राणि तोमराश्च धनूंषि च॥ प्रासाश्च विमलास्तीक्ष्णाः शक्त्यश्च कनकोज्ज्वला:। वैजयन्त्यश्च नागानां संक्रुद्धेन किरीटिना।॥
en: This day you will behold in battle a terrible massacre. Auspicious, mighty and gold-decked armors of heroes will be splintered into pieces with arrows of close knots; the tops of standards, the tomaras and bows, and resplendent and sharp lances, and dares of the effulgence of gold and the caparisons of elephants shall this day be torn and broken by the enraged diadem decked Arjuna.

sa: तस्मिन् हते भ्रातरि सूतपुत्रो वैकर्तनो वीर्यमथाददानः। प्रगृह्य दन्ताविव नागराजो महर्षभं व्याघ्र इवाभ्यधावत्॥ (कर्तनः शीघ्रमथो जघान। शिरो जहाराथ
en: His brother being slain, the son of Suta, Vikartana's son, gathering his energy. Rushed towards that foremost of men like an elephant chief, with the two tusks out or like a tiger. And Vikartana's son quickly wounded Arjuna with twelve arrows.

sa: मे शृणोमि कालो हिंसते धर्मवीर्य सोऽयं प्राप्तो वर्तते धर्मपीडा। पुराधर्मो वर्तते नेह यावत् तावद् गच्छामः सुरलोकं चिराय॥
en: It is heard that Time attacks the energy of virtue. That Time has come upon us. Hence, virtue is afflicted. It is proper that I should go to Heaven for good, before sin assails the world and establishes itself fully here.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततस्तस्मिन् प्रतिज्ञाते भीष्मेण कुरुनन्दन॥ कृष्णद्वैपायनं काली चिन्तयामास वै मुनिम्। स वेदान् विब्रुवन् धीमान् मातुर्विज्ञाय चिन्तितम्॥ प्रादुर्बभूवाविदितः क्षणेन कुरुनन्दन। तस्मै पूजां ततः कृत्वा सुताय विधिपूर्वकम्॥ परिष्वज्य च बाहुभ्यां प्रस्रवैरभ्यषिञ्चता मुमोच बाष्पं दाशेयी पुत्रं दृष्ट्वा चिरस्य तु॥
en: Vaishampayana said : O descendant of the Kuru race, when Bhishma said this, Kali (Satyavati) thought of the Rishi Krishna Dvaipayana Dvaipayana, who was then interpreting the Vedas, came at once to his mother without any body knowing it, as soon as he found that he had been thought of. She (Satyavati), having welcomed her son in all due forms, embraced him with her arms and bathed him with her breast milk. The daughter of the fisherman (Satyavati) shed much tears to see her son after a long time.

sa: अथाब्रवीद्राजपुत्रो भरतं धर्मिणां वरम्। अर्थोपहितया वाचा मधुरं रघुनन्दनः।॥ पितुर्भवनमासाद्य प्रवेश्य च महात्मनः। कौसल्यां च सुमित्रां च कैकेयीमभिवादय॥
en: Having reached and entered his ancestral palace and bowed to Kausalyä, Sumitra and Kaikeyī, the high-souled prince, the enhancer of the joy of the descendants of Raghu, addressed Bharata the foremost of the pious, with sweet words instinct with meaning, saying.

sa: कोऽयं कस्य कुतो वायं किंनिमित्तमिहागतः। कथं त्वया सहानेन संवादः कृत इत्युत॥ आचक्ष्व नो विशालाक्षि मा भूत्ते सुभगे भयम्। संवादमसितापाङ्गि त्वया किं कृतवानयम्॥
en: Who is this? And whence, and wherefore has he come here? And why did he carry on converse with you? Tell us this, you of expansive eyes. O lucky one, entertain no fear. And, O you having eyes with dark outer corners, what is the talk that this one has held with you?

sa: आपानशाला विचितास्तथा पुष्पगृहाणि च। चित्रशालाश्च विचिता भूयः क्रीडागृहाणि च ॥ निष्कुटान्तररथ्याश्च विमानानि च सर्वशः। इति संचिन्त्य भूयोऽपि विचेतुमुपचक्रमे॥ भूमीगृहांश्चैत्यगृहान् गृहातिगृहकानपि। उत्पतन् निपतंश्चापि तिष्ठन् गच्छन् पुनः क्वचित्॥ अपवृण्वंश्च द्वाराणि कपाटान्यवघट्टयन्। प्रविशन् निष्पतंश्चापि प्रपतन्त्रुत्पतन्निव॥
en: I have again searched the picture galleries and the sporting-structures, and edifices, and roads passing through gardens, as well as the car." Having thought thus, Hanuman again set about searching the subterranean abodes, religious buildings, and many-storied mansions. And flying up, and coming down, and staying, and going at places, and opening doors, and shutting others, and entering and issuing out, and falling down as if darting up, that mighty monkey began to range on all sides.

sa: तस्य तद् वचनं श्रुत्वा सम्पातेः प्रीतिवर्धनम्॥ अङ्गदप्रमुखाः सर्वे ततः प्रस्थापिता वयम्। विन्ध्यादुत्थाय सम्प्राप्ताः सागरस्यान्तमुत्तमम्॥ त्वदर्शने कृतोत्साहा हृष्टाः पुष्टाः प्लवङ्गमाः। अङ्गदप्रमुखा सर्वे वेलोपान्तमुपागताः॥
en: Hearing those words of Sampāti, enhancing our delight, we all, headed by Angada, left that place. And leaping from the crest of Vindhya mountain we reached the excellent brink of the Ocean. Being greatly anxious to behold you and delighted, those plump monkeys headed by Angada, arrived at the banks of the main.

sa: चतुर्दश सहस्राणि रक्षसां भीमकर्मणाम्। निहतानि जनस्थाने शरैरग्निशिखोपमैः॥ खरश्च निहतः संख्ये त्रिशिराश्च निपातितः। दूषणश्च महातेजा रामेण विदितात्मना॥ ।
en: (It was for her) that fourteen thousand Rākşasas of terrible deeds were destroyed at Janasthāna with arrow resembling the flame of fire. And Khara was killed in battle, and Trisirā was discomfited and the mighty Dūşaņa by Rāma, knowing his ownself.

sa: अहो स्वामिनि ते भक्तिरहो वीर्यमहो धृतिः॥ दिष्ट्या दृष्टा त्वया देवी रामपत्नी यशस्विनी। दिष्ट्या त्यक्ष्यति काकुत्स्थः शोकं सीतावियोगजम्।।४८
en: Oh for your fidelity! Oh for your prowess! Oh for your fortitude! By luck had you seen that exalted one, the illustrious wife of Rāma, by luck it is that Kākutstha shall forego his sorrow in consequence of separation from Sītā.

sa: सरलान् कर्णिकारांश्च खजूरांश्च सुपुष्पितान् । प्रियालान् मुचुलिन्दांश्च कुटजान् केतकानपि॥ प्रियङ्गुन् गन्धपूर्णांश्च नीपान् सप्तच्छदांस्तथा। असनान् कोविदारांश्च करवीरांश्च पुष्पितान्॥ पुष्पभारनिबद्धांश्च तथा मुकुलितानपि। पादपान् विहगाकीर्णान् पवनाधूतमस्तकान्॥ हंसकारण्डवाकीर्णा वापी: पद्मोत्पलावृताः। आक्रीडान् विविधारम्यान्विविधांश्च जलाशयान्॥ संततान् विविधैर्वृक्षैः सर्वर्तुफलपुष्पितैः। उद्यानानि च रम्याणि ददर्श कपिकुञ्जरः॥
en: That elephant of a monkey surveyed Saralas, and Karņikāras, and dates in full flower, priyalas, Muculindas, Kutajas and Ketakas, Priyangus warm with aroma, and Nipas, and Saptachchhadas; Asanas, Kovidaras, and flowering Karavīras, and trees bearing blossoms, filled with swans and Kārandavas, and covered with lotuses and lilies; and charming sporting hills* and various watery expanses; and extensive tracts covered with diverse trees bearing flowers and furies at all seasons, and gardens exceedingly beautiful to behold. *Sporting hills according to Kataka. According to others, akrira means a grove in general.

sa: देव्युवाच किं नाम दानं नियमं तपो वा कुर्यामहं येन पतिर्ममाद्या लभेत भागं भगवानचिन्त्यो ह्यधु तथा भागमथो तृतीयम्॥
en: Uma said What are those gifts, what those vows, and what those penances, that I should practise by means of which my illustrious consort may be able to get a half or a third share of the offerings in sacrifices. are

sa: प्रदीपैः काञ्चनैस्त गन्धतैलावसेचितैः। परिवर्महाराज प्रज्वलद्भिः समन्ततः॥ स तैः परिवृतो राजा प्रदीपैः काञ्चनैर्व्वलन्। शुशुभे चन्द्रमा युक्तो दीप्तैरिव महाग्रहैः॥
en: That lord paramount of all men honorea all these men in return. Many high-souled persons then surrounded him on all sides with golden lamps, lighted and fed with fragrant oil. Thus surrounded by those lighted lamps made of gold, king Duryodhana,

sa: अथवा द्रुपदो राजा महद्भिर्वित्तसंचयैः। पुत्राश्चास्य प्रलोभ्यन्ताममात्याश्चैव सर्वशः॥ परित्यजेद् यथा राजा कुन्तीपुत्रं युधिष्ठिरम्। अथ तत्रैव वा तेषां निवासं रोचयन्तु ते॥ इहैषां दोषवद्वासं वर्णयन्तु पृथक् पृथक्। ते भिद्यमानास्तत्रैव मनः कुर्वन्तु पाण्डवाः॥
en: Or let the king Drupada with his sons and ail his ministers of state be tempted by the presents of large wealth, so that they may abandon the cause of the son of Kunti, Yudhishthira. Or let them (our spies) speak to each of them separately the inconvenience of this place (Hastinapur) and induce them to live there (in Panchala.) Thus separated from the Kurus, they may live permanently there.

sa: देवराजोऽस्मि भद्रं ते इह चास्मि शुचिस्मिते॥ अहं त्वां कार्यनिद्दध्यर्थं राघवस्य महात्मनः। साहाय्यं कल्पयिष्यामि मा शुचो जनकात्मजे ॥
en: I am the sovereign of the celestials. Good betide you! I am here, O you of luminous smiles! For securing success to the work of the magnanimous Rāghava, I will lend my aid to you. Do not, Odaughter of Janaka, grieve.

sa: अथाश्विनौ प्रहस्यैतामबूतां पुनरेव तु। कथं त्वमसि कल्याणि पित्रा दत्ता गताध्वने।॥ भ्राजसेऽस्मिन् वने भीरु विद्युत्सौदामनी यथा। न देवेष्वपि तुल्यां हि त्वया पश्याव भाविनि॥
en: Ashvins then again spoke to her with smiles, “O auspicious one, why has your gather bestowed you on a man who is verging on death? O timid one, you shine in this forest like the flashing lightning. O beautiful lady, we have never seen any one like you even in the celestials region.

sa: तथा सनियमामेव सोऽमिगम्याभिवाद्य च। उवाच वचनं रामो हर्षयंस्तामिदं वरम्॥ अम्ब पित्रा नियुक्तोऽस्मि प्रजापालनकर्मणि। भविता श्वोऽभिषेको मे यथा मे शासनं पितुः॥ सीतयाप्युपवस्तव्या रजनीयं मया सह। एवमुक्तमुपाध्यायैः स हि मामुक्तवान् पिता॥
en: Rāma, approaching and saluting her engaged in auspicious observance, addressed her in excellent words, cheering her up, O mother, by my father have I been appointed to the task of governing the people. And, agreeably to the desire of my father, to morrow will take place my installation; To night Sītā will fast along with me, the priests have said thus, and this also has been declared by my father.

sa: वक्तव्यं च नरश्रेष्ठ श्रूयतां वचनं मम। भ्राता यवीयान् धर्मज्ञ एष राजा कुशध्वजः॥ अस्य धर्मात्मनो राजन् रूपेणाप्रतिमं भुवि। सुताद्वयं नरश्रेष्ठ पत्न्यर्थं वरयामहे ॥ भरतस्य कुमारस्य शत्रुघ्नस्य च धीमतः। वरये ते सुते राजंस्तयोरर्थे महात्मनोः॥
en: Now do you, O foremost of men, listen to my words. This youthful brother of yours, king Kusadhvaja, O you versed in morality, this pious-souled one, O king, has, O prime of men, a couple of daughters, unparalleled on earth in beauty, whom we would ask for, to become wives to the prince Bharata and the intelligent Satrughna; as we, O king, ask for your own daughters in the interests of those high-souled ones (Rama and Laksmana).4-6

sa: अनुक्त्वा च पिबन् प्रश्नान् पीत्वैव न भविष्यसि। एवमुक्तस्ततः पार्थः सव्यसाची धनंजयः॥ अवज्ञायैव तां वाचं पीत्वैव निपपात ह।
en: If however you drink before answering my questions, you will die as soon as you will drink. Thus addressed, the son of Pritha, Dhananjaya who could draw his bow by his left hand. Disregarding those words, as he drank, fell dead.

sa: एवमेकायनगताः प्लवमाना गिरेगिरिम्। प्रकम्पयन्तो वेगेन गिरीणां शिखराणि च॥ ततः शाखामृगाः सर्वे प्लवमाना महाबलाः। बभञ्जुश्च नगांस्तत्र पुष्पितान् दुर्गमाश्रितान्॥
en: The monkeys thus sharing in the misery and happiness (of their chief) proceeded jumping from hill to hill shaking the summits thereof, with the velocity (of their persons). Thereupon those mighty monkeys, jumping, broke down the flowery trees of that stronghold.

sa: शक्रस्य तु वचः श्रुत्वा नाहं प्रीतमनाऽभवम्। अब्रुवंश्च तदा हृष्टो देवराजमिदं वचः॥ नाहं त्वत्तो वरं काक्षे नान्यस्मादपि दैवतात्। महादेवादृते सौम्य सत्यमेतद् ब्रवीमि ते॥
en: Hearing these words of Shakra I was not gladdened. O Krishna, I answered the king of the gods in these words, I do not wish any boon from you, or from any other god. O amiable deity, I tell you truly that it is Mahadeva only from whom I may ask for boons.

sa: तस्मादनार्जवे बुद्धिर्न कार्या ते कदाचन॥ असाधुभ्योऽस्य न भयं न चौरेभ्यो न राजतः। अकिंचित् कस्यचित् कुर्वन् निर्भयः शुचिरावसेत्॥
en: Therefore, do not ever think of doing a wrong act. One behaving in this way has no fear of dishonest men or thieves, or the king. Not having injured any one, such a man lives fearlessly and with a pure heart.

sa: सुदर्शनस्तु मनसा कर्मणा चक्षुषा गिरा। त्यक्तेति॒स्त्यक्तमन्युश्च स्मयमानोऽब्रवीदिदम्॥ सुरतं तेऽस्तु विप्राय्य प्रीतिर्हि परमा मम। गृहस्थस्य हि धर्मोऽत्र्यः सम्प्राप्तातिथिपूजनम्॥
en: Sudarshana was struck with wonder, but renouncing all, jealousy and anger by look, word, deed, or thought, said Do you enjoy yourself, O Brahmana! It is a great pleasure to me! A householder acquires the highest merit by honouring a guest.

sa: ऊचुः परस्परं चेदं सर्व एव समाहिताः। उभौ रामस्य सदृशौ बिम्बाद्विम्बमिरोद्धतौ॥ जटिलौ यदि न स्यातां न वल्कलधरौ यदि। विशेष नाधिगच्छामो गायतो राघवस्य च॥ एवं प्रभाषमाणेषु पौरजानपदेषु च। प्रवृत्तमादितः पूर्वसर्ग नारददर्शितम्॥
en: And they all attentively said to one anotherBoth of them take after Rāma, like to a bubble resembling the one it rises from. There would not have been perceived the least difference between them and Rama had they not been clothed in dark and used clotted hair. The citizens and villagers speaking thus with one another Kuśa and Lava chanted twenty sections beginning from the first, pointed out by Narada.

sa: यत् कर्णशल्यप्रमुखैः क्षत्रियैर्लोकविश्रुतैः। नानतं बलवदभिर्हि धनुर्वेदपरायणैः॥ तत् कथं त्वकृतास्त्रेण प्राणतो दुर्बलीयसा। बटुमात्रेण शक्यं हि सज्यं कर्तुं धनुर्द्विजाः॥
en: “How can a stripping of a Brahmana unpractised in arms and weak a strength, string that bow which such celebrated Kshatriyas like Shalya and others endued with great might and accomplished in the science and practice of arms could not string?

sa: ग्राम्यारण्याश्चौषधीश्च दुदुहे पय एव च। षड्रसं चामृतनिभं रसायनमनुत्तमम्॥ भोजनीयानि पेयानि भक्ष्याणि विविधानि च। लेह्यान्यमृतकल्पानि चोप्याणि च तथार्जुन॥ रत्नानि च महार्हाणि वासांसि विविधानि च। तैः कामैः सर्वसम्पूर्णैः पूजितश्च महीपतिः॥ सामात्यः सबलश्चैव तुतोष स भृशं तदा।
en: O Arjuna, the Rishi received from her various wild fruits and grown corn of gardens and fields, milk, many excellent nutritious was viands filled with six different kinds of juice which was like ambrosia itself, various other kinds of enjoyable things of ambrosial taste, things for drinking and eating, for lapping and sucking and many precious gems and various costly robes. With these desirable objects in profusion, the king (Vishvamitra) worshipped. And he with his ministers and troops was became exceedingly glad.

sa: भूयो भूयः सर्वशस्तेऽब्रुवंस्तं किं ते प्रियं करवामाद्य विद्वन्। प्रीता वयं मोक्षिताश्चैव सर्वे कामं किं ते करवामाद्य वत्स॥
en: They all again and again asked him, "O learned one, what good can we do to you? We are exceedingly pleased with you, for we have been all saved by you. O child, (tell us) what can we do for you?

sa: कुन्त्युवाच इयं तु कन्या दुपदस्य राज्ञः तवानुजाभ्यां मयि संनिविष्टा। यथोचितं पुत्र मयापि चोक्तं समेत्य भुङ्क्तेति नृप प्रमादात्॥
en: Kunti said: This daughter of the king Yajnasena, upon being represented to me by your younger brothers as the “Alms” they had obtained, O king, from ignorance I said what was proper, namely, “Enjoy all of you what you have got.”

sa: जानीयुर्यदि ते वृत्तं प्रशंसन्ति न वा पुनः। कच्चिद् रोचेज्जनपदे कच्चिद् राष्ट्रे च मे यशः॥ धर्मज्ञानां धृतिमतां संग्रामेष्वपलायिनाम्।
en: Indeed, he should know whether his conduct is or is not, generally applauded, or is, or is not, liked by the people of the provinces, and whether he has, or has not, succeeded in gaining a good name in his kingdom.

sa: दैवे पूर्वं प्रकुपिते मानुषे कालचोदिते। तद्विद्वांसोऽनुपश्यन्ति ज्ञानदिव्येन चक्षुषा॥ प्रायश्चित्तविधिं चात्र जपहोमांश्च तद्विदः। मङ्गलानि च कुर्वन्ति शमयन्त्यहितानि च॥
en: When the gods become angry and men are impelled by Destiny, learned persons, seeing cverything with the eye of divine knowledge, perform various auspicious acts and expiatory rites including Homa and the silent recitation of Mantras, and thus counteract all evils.

sa: भृतो वृद्धो यो न बिभर्ति पुत्रः स्वयोनिजः पितरं मातरं च। तद् वै पापं भ्रूणहत्याविशिष्टं तस्मान्नान्य पापकृदस्ति लोके।॥
en: That son, who, being born of parents and brought up by them and when he comes to age, does not maintain them on his turn, commits the sin of killing a foetus. There is no sinner like him in the world.

sa: तत् तादृशं प्रेक्ष्य महारथस्य कर्णस्य वीर्यं च परैरसह्यम। दृष्ट्वा च कर्णेन धनंजयस्य तथाऽऽजिमध्ये निहतं तदस्त्रम्॥ ततस्त्वमर्षी क्रोधसंदीप्तनेत्रो वातात्मजः पाणिना पाणिमाछेत्। ममर्षितो निःश्वसज्जातमन्युः॥
en: They saw the power of the great hero Karna, overpower the enemies and his weapon to baffle all those of Dhananjaya in that fight. The son of Wind God, the wrathful Bhimasena, with eyes kindling with rage, pressed his own hands and drawing heavy breaths and greatly excited addressed Arjuna, of never-failing aim.

sa: अप्रवृत्तो च सीतायाः पापमेव करिष्यति। तस्मात् क्षममिहाद्यैव्र गन्तुं प्रायोपवेशनम्॥ त्यक्त्वा पुत्रांश्च दारांश्च धनानि च गृहाणि च ।
en: Sītā not having been found out, Sugrīva, for certain, shall commit this sin.* Therefore it is fit that, forsaking our sons, and wives, and wealth, and homes, we this very day sit down to starve ourselves to death. *i.e. slay us.

sa: विषण्णः सन् विषण्णेन दुःखितो दुःखभागिना । स जगहेऽथ तं भ्राता दृष्ट्वा लक्ष्मणमागतम्॥ विहाय सीतां विजने वने राक्षससेविते।
en: And depressed in spirit, he was rendered still more sad by that one who, afflicted with depression shared his sorrow. And, seeing that (Laksmana) bad come, leaving Sita in that solitary wood frequented by Rākşasas, his brother fell to reprimanding him.
